content.passage:
One of the biggest controversies over the Industrial Revolution is how it affected the working class. The oldest debates were over whether the standards of living rose or fell. Those that believed they fell claimed that the capitalists __(26)__ every ounce of surplus they could from the working class. Those that believed the standards of living rose claimed that the environment was consumer-friendly, with more and more goods __(27)__ to the working class every year.

Today's historians agree that overall, the standards of living __(28)__ . They do not agree, however, on when this improvement __(29)__ .

In an effort to solve this controversy, historians have attempted to define __(30)__ what "standard of living" means. They all seem to agree that it should mean happiness, but happiness is impossible to measure. Instead, historians __(31)__ use "real income" as the measure for the standards of living. Real income is money __(32)__ and then adjusted according to the cost of living. However, it does not take into account unemployment, pollution, health, life expectancy, or free time.

After __(33)__ debate and analysis of the average income, historians have agreed to disagree on whether there was rapid or slow economic growth during the Industrial Revolution. Instead, they have decided to __(34)__ how the Industrial Revolution was affected by other events. They have determined that the Industrial Revolution had an overall positive __(35)__ , but it quite possibly was neutralized by negative events such as wars, high taxes, and rapid population growth.

S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
9 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
The oldest debates were over whether the standards of living rose or fell.
第1段，第2句
"介词 + whether 从句" 是四六级与考研阅读中极高频出现的语法结构，掌握此句式对于理清长难句中的介词宾语关系具有高度代表性。
Those that believed they fell claimed that the capitalists squeezed every ounce of surplus they could from the working class.
第1段，第3句
“主语 + 定语从句 + 谓语 + 宾语从句”是四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的复杂长难句句型。
Those that believed the standards of living rose claimed that the environment was consumer-friendly, with more and more goods available to the working class every year.
第1段，第4句
“代词 + 定语从句 + 谓语 + 宾语从句 + 介词短语补充说明”是各类英语考试长难句中极具代表性的高频结构，教学与练习的迁移性极强。

They all seem to agree that it should mean happiness, but happiness is impossible to measure.
第3段，第2句
句中包含了 "seem to do"、"agree that ..." 以及 "be + adj + to do" 等高频考点句式，结构极具代表性，适合作为典型例句供学生迁移复用。
Real income is money earned and then adjusted according to the cost of living.
第3段，第4句
本句采用了极其典型的"名词 + 过去分词短语后置修饰"句式（"money earned and then adjusted..."），这是各大考试阅读理解中定义类概念高频出现的代表性结构。
However, it does not take into account unemployment, pollution, health, life expectancy, or free time.
第3段，第5句
“句首转折副词 + 主谓 + 多个并列名词宾语”是四六级及考研阅读与写作中高度典型的长句排比/列举模式，可高频复用。
After exhausting debate and analysis of the average income, historians have agreed to disagree on whether there was rapid or slow economic growth during the Industrial Revolution.
第4段，第1句
句中 "After + 动名词/名词短语" 作状语以及 "agree to disagree on whether..." 结构在四六级和考研阅读中极其常见，属于高频常考的标准学术议论文句式。
Instead, they have decided to interpret how the Industrial Revolution was affected by other events.
第4段，第2句
“主句 + 不定式 + 疑问词引导宾语从句”属于四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的高频句式，掌握后迁移复用价值极高。

They have determined that the Industrial Revolution had an overall positive effect, but it quite possibly was neutralized by negative events such as wars, high taxes, and rapid population growth.
第4段，第3句
“主句 + 宾语从句 + 并列连词 + 被动句”是学术阅读及四六级、考研英语中极其高频出现的经典句式，极具代表性。

main.directions: Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports. At the end of each news report, you will hear two

lines.en: A man was left with a $1,000 bill, after his 6-year-old son ordered a virtual buffet of food from several restaurants last weekend. This led to a string of unexpected deliveries, and maybe a starring role in an advertisement campaign.
lines.cn: 上周末，一名男子的6岁儿子从多家餐厅订购了一顿“虚拟自助餐”，结果给他留下了一张1000美元的账单。这引发了一连串意外送餐，也可能让他在一场广告宣传活动中担任主角。

lines.en: Keith Stonehouse said the food piled up quickly at his home Saturday night, after he let his son use his cell phone to play a game before bed. He said the youngster instead used his father's online food ordering account to order food from one restaurant after another. The boy's mother, Christine Stonehouse, said that the online food app has reached out to the family and offered them a $1,000 gift card. The company also is considering using the family in an online promotional campaign.
lines.cn: 基思·斯通豪斯说，上周六晚上，他让儿子睡前用自己的手机玩游戏，之后食物很快就堆满了家里。他说，孩子没有玩游戏，而是使用父亲的在线点餐账户，一家接一家地订购食物。男孩的母亲克里斯蒂娜·斯通豪斯说，这款在线点餐应用已经联系了他们一家，并向他们提供了一张价值1000美元的礼品卡。该公司还在考虑让这一家人参与一场线上宣传活动。Questions 1 and 2 are based on the news report you have just heard.

lines.en: Most of the food went into the family's refrigerators. They also invited some neighbors over to eat some of it. The father is planning to change his password.
lines.cn: 大部分食物都放进了家里的冰箱。他们还邀请了一些邻居来吃掉其中一部分。孩子的父亲打算更改密码。

lines.en: Animal behaviour experts looked at more than 100 research papers. They examined how visitors affected the behaviour of more than 250 species in zoos. They found that elephants socialised more with each other during public feeding times. After public feeding times, they were more likely to search for food and less likely to be inactive. In the presence of many visitors, elephants were less likely to use repetitive behaviours which often indicate boredom.
lines.cn: 动物行为专家查阅了100多篇研究论文。他们研究了参观者如何影响动物园中250多种动物的行为。他们发现，在面向公众的喂食时段，大象彼此之间的社交活动更多。公众喂食时段结束后，大象更有可能寻找Questions 3 and 4 are based on the news report you have just heard.食物，也不太可能处于不活动状态。在众多参观者在场时，大象较少表现出重复性行为，而这类行为通常表明它们感到无聊。

lines.en: Visitors had a similar effect on some other species too, including polar bears, certain jungle cats and black-tailed plain dogs. Some animal species have been born and raised in zoos, and so have likely become used to the presence of humans. Zoo visitors are often aspects of a zoo animal's environment that animals cannot control, and as such can be stressful, although some species appear to show good adaptability to the changing conditions of visitors.
lines.cn: 参观者对其他一些物种也产生了类似影响，包括北极熊、某些丛林猫科动物和黑尾草原犬。一些动物物种出生并成长于动物园，因此很可能已经习惯了人类的存在。对动物园里的动物而言，参观者通常是其环境中动物无法控制的因素，因此可能会造成压力，尽管有些物种似乎表现出对参观者状况变化的良好适应能力。

lines.en: Denver is suspending its popular electric bike incentive program. The program was launched in April. It allowed Denver residents to apply for $400 in government funds before buying an electric bike from a participating shop. Residents who met certain income qualifications could qualify for $1,200. More than 3,000 Denver residents applied for incentives within the first 3 weeks.
lines.cn: 丹佛暂停了广受欢迎的电动自行车激励计划。该计划于4月启动，允许丹佛居民在从参与计划的商店购买电动自行车之前，申请400美元的政府补助。符合特定收入条件的居民可获得1,200美元。启动后的前3周内，超过3,000名丹佛居民申请了补助。

lines.en: The city then changed the program to limit the number of applications each month. On Monday, the city announced the pause. "We're honored to be a part of transforming the way Denver wants to move around," said Grace Rink, Denver's chief climate officer. "We exhausted three years' worth of funding in six months." The city said the program has put 4,400 electric bikes on the streets of Denver and invested $8.6 million into the local economy. The city has provided 2,200 incentives to lower-income residents that represent 68% of the program funding. The city expects to resume the program early next year. It also plans design changes to make participation easier and increase access to the program.
lines.cn: 随后，该市对计划进行了调整，限制每月的申请数量。周一，该市宣布暂停该计划。丹佛首席气候官格蕾丝·林克说：“我们很荣幸能够参与改变丹佛人出行的方式。”她说：“我们在6个月内用尽了原本可供3年使用的资金。”该市表示，这项计划已让4,400辆电动自行车行驶在丹佛街头，并向当地经济投入了860万美元。该市已向低收入居民提供2,200项补助，占计划资金的68%。该市预计明年年初恢复该计划，同时还计划进行设计调整，以便居民更容易参与并扩大计划的覆盖范围。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Hey, Mike, what do you think of the museum you visited today?
lines.cn: W: 嘿，迈克，你觉得今天参观的博物馆怎么样？

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Hey, Sue. The museum is great, very interesting. They have loads of stuff there on display. The primitive tools early humans used tell a lot about their life, but my favorite is the coin collection. They have some coins that are over 2,000 years old.
lines.cn: M: 嘿，苏。这个博物馆很棒，非常有意思。那里展出了很多东西。早期人类使用的原始工具能让我们了解到很多他们的生活情况，不过我最喜欢的是钱币收藏。他们有些钱币已经有两千多年的历史了。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: That sounds cool.
lines.cn: W: 听起来很酷。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Yeah, what did you do today?
lines.cn: M: 是啊，你今天做了什么？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Kathy and I just wandered through the old city centre. The streets are narrow but beautiful with plenty of charm. We saw the Trevi Fountain, which is in all the guidebooks.
lines.cn: W: 我和凯西只是逛了逛老城区。街道虽然狭窄，却很漂亮，充满了魅力。我们看了特莱维喷泉，所有旅游指南上都有介绍。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: How do you like it?
lines.cn: M: 你觉得怎么样？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: It's very pretty, but it was overcrowded with tourists.
lines.cn: W: 非常漂亮，不过游客太多了，挤得水泄不通。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Yeah, well, it's crowded everywhere. It is August after all, the busiest month of the year.
lines.cn: M: 是啊，到处都很拥挤。毕竟现在是八月，一年中最繁忙的月份。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Yes, it's like the whole world is here on holiday, including us. What will you do tomorrow?
lines.cn: W: 是啊，感觉全世界的人都来这里度假了，包括我们。你明天打算做什么？

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: I haven't decided yet. I was thinking of doing what you did today—wandering the old streets and taking pictures. I was also thinking of visiting the square with the Spanish steps.
lines.cn: M: 我还没决定。我在考虑做你今天做的事，逛逛老街，拍拍照。我还在考虑去看看有西班牙阶梯的那个广场。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: What is that? I haven't heard of it.
lines.cn: W: 那是什么地方？我没听说过。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: It's a square where on one side, there are some very wide steps with flowers that go up to a church. It's also in all the tourist guidebooks. It's very famous and pretty. I was also thinking of seeing that tomorrow.
lines.cn: M: 那是一个广场，广场一侧有一段很宽的台阶，台阶上摆满了鲜花，一直通向一座教堂。旅游指南上也都有介绍。那里非常有名，也很漂亮。我也在考虑明天去看看。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: It sounds very nice. Do you mind if Kathy and I join you tomorrow?
lines.cn: W: 听起来很不错。你介意明天我和凯西跟你一起去吗？

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Not at all. I spent the whole day today pretty much alone. Doing tourist stuff with others would be a welcome change.
lines.cn: M: 当然不介意。我今天基本上独自待了一整天。和别人一起做些游客会做的事，换换方式也挺不错的。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Let me ask her first, but I'm sure she'll be up for it.
lines.cn: W: 我先问问她，不过我相信她会愿意去的。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Can you give me advice about being successful at a new job? I start mine next week.
lines.cn: M: 你能给我一些关于如何在新工作中取得成功的建议吗？我下周就要开始工作了。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Sure. It's important not to undermine the significance of the first few days of your job, since this is the best time to create a solid first impression.
lines.cn: W: 当然。千万不要低估入职头几天的重要性，因为这段时间最适合树立良好的第一印象。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: That's a good point. I'll need to collaborate with my coworkers and I'm very aware of just how important others are for my success at work.
lines.cn: M: 你说得有道理。我需要和同事合作，而且我非常清楚别人对我在工作中的成功有多么重要。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: It's also important to understand your role thoroughly to gain a comprehensive picture of your job. The most important thing for you to do at first is to understand your role from multiple perspectives.
lines.cn: W: 彻底了解自己的职责也很重要，这样才能全面了解你的工作。你一开始最重要的事情，就是从多个角度了解自己的职责。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Why is that?
lines.cn: M: 为什么呢？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Well, what you do at work is not just limited to your job description. You need to consider how your work relates to other people within the organization.
lines.cn: W: 这个嘛，你在工作中做的事情并不只是局限于职位描述。你需要考虑自己的工作与组织内部其他人的工作有什么联系。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Oh, right. So, for example, certain reports that I create at the end of the month may be used by a team in another department.
lines.cn: M: 哦，对。比如说，我在月底制作的某些报告可能会被另一个部门的团队使用。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: That's right. And in that respect, it's also important to learn about the business to see the big picture.
lines.cn: W: 没错。从这个角度来说，了解公司业务、掌握全局也很重要。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: You mean like knowing about the history of the company.
lines.cn: M: 你的意思是要了解公司的历史之类的吗？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Kind of, but more like knowing the details of the products and services that the company exists to deliver. Learning about the business will give you a chance to understand how your role fits into the bigger picture.
lines.cn: W: 算是吧，不过更重要的是了解公司赖以存在的那些产品和服务的具体情况。了解公司业务能让你明白自己的职责是如何融入更大的整体的。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Okay. I'm feeling a bit uneasy about meeting my boss as well.
lines.cn: M: 好的。不过，想到要见我的老板，我还是有点不安。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: That's to be expected. However, it's crucial that you get to know the people who have decision- making authority to gain insight regarding how the business is run and decisions are made.
lines.cn: W: 这是可以理解的。不过，了解那些拥有决策权的人至关重要，这样你才能深入了解公司是如何运营的，以及决策是如何做出的。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Great advice. Thanks.
lines.cn: M: 这个建议太好了。谢谢。

lines.en: Contrary to popular belief, consumers aren't as smart as they like to believe. Many consumers report comparing multiple competing brands and prices when evaluating a purchase. However, research indicates that this is not actually the case. What consumers really think or feel often contradicts what they say. A big reason is that they are driven by unconscious urges, the biggest of which is emotion.
lines.cn: 与普遍看法相反，消费者并没有他们自认为的那么聪明。许多消费者表示，在评估一项购买时，他们会比较多个相互竞争的品牌及其价格。然而，研究表明，实际情况并非如此。消费者真正的想法或感受往往与他们所说的相矛盾。一个重要原因是，他们受到无意识冲动的驱使，其中最主要的就是情感。

lines.en: Emotion is what really drives the purchasing behaviors, and also, decision making in general. Good marketers keep in mind this important fact all the time, and examples of emotion-based campaigns are everywhere. Think for a moment, what is actually being sold in most marketing campaigns? Luxury goods target our feelings of self-worth, acceptance, and status in the world. Communication devices excite us by offering a connection to friends, family and a broader network of people. And many other products, such as rings, target emotions related to love and relationships.
lines.cn: 真正驱动购买行为的，是情感；一般而言，决策也是如此。优秀的营销人员始终牢记这一重要事实，而以情感为基础的营销活动随处可见。请想一想，大多数营销活动实际上销售的是什么？奢侈品瞄准的是我们关于自我价值、认同感以及社会地位的感受。通信设备通过提供与朋友、家人以及更广泛人际网络的联系，使我们感到兴奋。许多其他产品，例如戒指，则瞄准与爱情和人际关系相关的情感。

lines.en: As marketers, we should focus on the features of the product, but we must also sell the lifestyle and the feeling. The key is to highlight the emotional response a consumer will have by using the product. To achieve the highest emotional response, we should target our consumer through many different senses. A lot of what drives consumers is subconscious behavior. But this isn't a bad thing. There's nothing manipulative about helping consumers achieve desired states of emotion.
lines.cn: 作为营销人员，我们应当关注产品的功能，但也必须销售一种生活方式和一种感受。关键在于突出消费者使用产品后将产生的情感反应。为了达到最强烈的情感反应，我们应当通过许多不同的感官来触达消费者。驱动消费者行为的诸多因素都属于潜意识行为。但这并不是一件坏事。帮助消费者获得期望的情感状态，并没有任何操纵性。

lines.en: Plastics have for years been used to make nearly everything that surrounds us. But along the way, they escaped the confines of packaging and objects and settled in the environment, the food we eat and the air we breathe.
lines.cn: 多年来，塑料一直被用于制造我们周围几乎所有的东西。但在这一过程中，它们逃离了包装和物品的束缚，进入了环境、我们所吃的食物以及所呼吸的空气中。

lines.en: Americans are consuming and breathing in a lot of plastic. Based on available data, Americans take in an estimated 74,000 to 121,000 microplastic particles every year. However, scientists believe the true number is probably much higher, because for some likely sources of microplastics, there were no strong data available.
lines.cn: 美国人正在摄入并吸入大量塑料。根据现有数据估算，美国人每年摄入的微塑料颗粒数量在7.4万至12.1万之间。然而，科学家认为真实数量可能高得多，因为对于一些很可能的微塑料来源，目前没有可靠的数据。

lines.en: Microplastics get into food and air in several ways. Many start off as part of larger plastic objects, which over time fragment into smaller and smaller pieces until they become tiny: 5 millimeters or less in diameter. They are breathed in or consumed by animals, and then become our food. The particles float through the air until people breathe them in. They also settle on the food that people eat.
lines.cn: 微塑料通过多种方式进入食物和空气。许多微塑料最初是较大塑料物品的一部分，随着时间的推移逐渐碎裂成越来越小的碎片，最终变得十分微小，直径仅为5毫米或更小。它们会被动物吸入或摄入，随后成为我们的食物。这些颗粒漂浮在空气中，直到人们将其吸入。它们也会沉积在供人们食用的食物上。

lines.en: Data shows that for Americans, air, bottled water and seafood were the biggest sources for breathed-in or consumed microplastics. Added sugars accounted for less, and salts, tap water and beer contributed minimal amounts. These estimates are conservative. The included foods only make up about 15% of the average American diet. It's not yet known how much plastic is contained in the remaining 85% of the typical diet.
lines.cn: 数据显示，对于美国人来说，空气、瓶装水和海鲜是吸入或摄入微塑料的最大来源。添加糖所占比例较小，而盐、自来水和啤酒所贡献的数量极少。这些估算是保守的。所纳入的食物仅约占美国人平均饮食的15%。典型饮食中剩余的85%含有多少塑料，目前尚不清楚。

lines.en: People looking to stay well as they age may want to adopt a pet animal, according to new data from the University of Michigan National Poll on Healthy Aging. For the survey, researchers polled about 2,000 U.S. adults from ages 50 to 80. 55% said they owned at least one pet. Dogs were the most common pet, followed by cats. But whatever the type of animal, the vast majority of owners said their pets boosted their mental and physical health.
lines.cn: 密歇根大学健康老龄化全国民意调查的最新数据显示，希望随着年龄增长保持健康的人或许可以考虑养一只宠物。调查中，研究人员询问了约2,000名年龄在50至80岁之间的美国成年人。55%的人表示自己至少养有一只宠物。狗是最常见的宠物，其次是猫。但无论饲养何种动物，绝大多数宠物主人都表示，宠物改善了他们的心理和身体健康。

lines.en: Nearly 90% of older pet owners said their animals helped them enjoy life and feel loved; roughly 80% said their pets reduced stress; and almost three-quarters said their pets provided a sense of purpose. However, people did report a few disadvantages to pet ownership. This included difficulty traveling and financial strains. 6% of pet owners said they'd fallen or injured themselves as a result of having a pet.
lines.cn: 近90%的老年宠物主人表示，宠物帮助他们享受生活并感受到关爱；约80%的人表示，宠物减轻了他们的压力；近四分之三的人表示，宠物让他们感到生活有目标。不过，人们确实也报告了养宠物带来的一些不利之处，包括出行困难和经济压力。6%的宠物主人表示，他们曾因养宠物而跌倒或受伤。

lines.en: Still, plenty of research has shown that just about anyone can benefit from their pet, since animals can lower stress, reduce symptoms of depression and anxiety and encourage physical activity. The new poll suggests that pet ownership may be especially beneficial for older adults, given how common loneliness and social isolation are within this age group. Human social support comes with a host of health benefits —less stress, lower rates of long-term disease and more—and research shows that interacting with pets can bring many of the same benefits.
lines.cn: 尽管如此，大量研究表明，几乎所有人都能从宠物身上受益，因为动物能够减轻压力，缓解抑郁和焦虑症状，并促进身体活动。这项新的民意调查表明，养宠物对老年人可能尤其有益，因为孤独和社会隔离在这一年龄群体中十分普遍。人类的社会支持能够带来一系列健康益处，包括减轻压力、降低长期疾病的发生率等；研究表明，与宠物互动也能带来许多相同的益处。

sentence_insights.text:
S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
57 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
A man was left with a $1,000 bill, after his 6-year-old son ordered a virtual buffet of food from several restaurants last weekend.
第1段，第1句
‘主句 + 时间/原因状语从句’的结构在阅读与写作中高度常见，具有极强的应用迁移价值。

Keith Stonehouse said the food piled up quickly at his home Saturday night, after he let his son use his cell phone to play a game before bed.
第2段，第1句
主句带宾语从句并在从句中再嵌套状语从句的结构，是各类英语考试长难句阅读与写作中极高频的经典句式，具有很强的可迁移性。
He said the youngster instead used his father's online food ordering account to order food from one restaurant after another.
第2段，第2句
“主句 + 省略引导词的宾语从句 + 不定式目的状语”是英语新闻叙事文本中极具代表性的高频结构，掌握后迁移价值高。
What does the news report say Keith Stonehouse is planning to do?
第2题题干
这种 "What do you say/think sb is doing" 形式的复合疑问句在英语阅读与听力测试中频繁出现，掌握其结构具有极高的复用与迁移价值。
Animal behaviour experts looked at more than 100 research papers.
第1段，第1句
“主语 + 短语动词 + 数量名词宾语”是学术阅读与考试中极常见的陈述句结构，掌握后迁移复用价值较高。
They examined how visitors affected the behaviour of more than 250 species in zoos.
第1段，第2句
“及物动词 + how 引导的宾语从句”是各大英语考试中极为高频且典型的基础句型，掌握后迁移价值高。

After public feeding times, they were more likely to search for food and less likely to be inactive.
第1段，第4句
’be more/less likely to do sth’ 属于学术阅读与写作中的极高频典型句式，掌握后复用迁移价值高。
Zoo visitors are often aspects of a zoo animal's environment that animals cannot control, and as such can be stressful, although some species appear to show good adaptability to the changing conditions of visitors.
第2段，第3句
“主句 + 定语从句 + 并列谓语 + 让步状语从句”的组合是四六级与考研阅读中极高频出现的复合句结构，掌握后可大量迁移应用于长难句拆解。
Why have some animal species likely become used to the presence of humans?
第4题题干
该句展现了非常标准的“Why + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形/分词”特殊疑问句句型，以及阅读中高频出现的 "become used to" 表达，具备极高的迁移复用价值。
It allowed Denver residents to apply for $400 in government funds before buying an electric bike from a participating shop.
第1段，第3句
句中 "allow sb to do sth" 搭配与 "before + 动名词" 状语结构均为四六级及考研真题中的高频经典句式，示范性强。
Residents who met certain income qualifications could qualify for $1,200.
第1段，第4句
“名词主语 + 定语从句 + 谓语动词 + 介词短语”是各类英语考试中极其高频的核心句式，掌握后可大量复用。

More than 3,000 Denver residents applied for incentives within the first 3 weeks.
第1段，第5句
“主语（数量+地点+名词）+ 谓语 + 介词短语（目的）+ 介词短语（时间）”是常考真题与新闻报道中极具代表性的基础陈述句式，复用迁移价值高。
"We're honored to be a part of transforming the way Denver wants to move around," said Grace Rink, Denver's chief climate officer.
第2段，第3句
“直接引语 + 倒装引述句 + the way 引导定语从句”是外刊新闻与四六级/考研阅读中极其高频出现的经典句式，可迁移性强。
The city has provided 2,200 incentives to lower-income residents that represent 68% of the program funding.
第2段，第6句
“核心事实主句 + 句尾定语从句补充数据特征”是各类英语考试阅读理解中极为高频的句式结构，具有很强的教学复用价值。
The primitive tools early humans used tell a lot about their life, but my favorite is the coin collection.
第2段，第4句
“名词 + 省略关系词的定语从句 + 谓语”以及“转折连词连接并列句”均属于各类英语考试中最常见的典型句式。
We saw the Trevi Fountain, which is in all the guidebooks.
第5段，第3句
主句接逗号及“which”引导的非限制性定语从句是英语阅读中极高频出现的典型句式，可迁移性强。
It is August after all, the busiest month of the year.
第8段，第2句
采用 "It is + 时间名词" 配合后置同位语补充说明的表达在日常英语与阅读理解中非常典型，迁移复用价值较高。

I was thinking of doing what you did today—wandering the old streets and taking pictures.
第10段，第2句
句中集成了过去进行时、宾语从句、动名词结构以及破折号后的并列分词作同位语，非常适合训练划成分与识别复杂非谓语修饰的能力。
M: It's a square where on one side, there are some very wide steps with flowers that go up to a church.
第12段，第1句
名词 + 关系副词定语从句 + 嵌套关系代词定语从句是真题阅读中描写空间景物时极高频出现的典型句式。
Do you mind if Kathy and I join you tomorrow?
第13段，第2句
“Do you mind if...” 是英语日常口语与考试中高频出现的礼貌询问句型，具有极高的典型性与复用价值。
What exhibits does the man like best in the museum he visited?
第8题题干
特殊疑问句叠加省略关系代词的定语从句在四六级听力和阅读中高频出现，具有极高的句式代表性与教学迁移价值。
Ask Kathy what her plan is.
第11题，A
“Ask/Tell + 人 + 特殊疑问词从句” 是各类英语考试中极高频出现的句型，高度典型且非常利于解题方法的迁移。
Ask Kathy if she'd like to see the square.
第11题，C
“Ask sb if...”是极其典型且高频的日常与考试句式，掌握后可无缝迁移至各类转述与询问场景。

Tell Kathy Mike would like to have a change.
第11题，D
“祈使动词 + 间接宾语 + 省略连词的宾语从句”是日常生活与各类英语考试中极高频出现的口语化及书面表达句式，迁移性极强。
It's important not to undermine the significance of the first few days of your job, since this is the best time to create a solid first impression.
第2段，第2句
该句用到了考研与四六级阅读及写作中极高频出现的 'It is adj. to do sth' 形式主语句型和 'since' 引导的原因状语从句，结构非常标准典型，极具教学与迁移价值。
I'll need to collaborate with my coworkers and I'm very aware of just how important others are for my success at work.
第3段，第2句
由 "be aware of + how/what..." 引导宾语从句是英语写作与阅读中的高频典型句式，从句中表语前置的结构在考研及四六级阅读中极具代表性。
W: It's also important to understand your role thoroughly to gain a comprehensive picture of your job.
第4段，第1句
"It is + 形容词 + to do sth. + to do sth." 是各类英语考试中高频出现的经典句型，高度典型且规则明确，掌握后迁移复用价值极高。
The most important thing for you to do at first is to understand your role from multiple perspectives.
第4段，第2句
"The... thing is to do..." 属于阅读与写作中极高频出现的典型句型，学会分析该句结构可直接迁移至大量同类表达中。

However, it's crucial that you get to know the people who have decision-making authority to gain insight regarding how the business is run and decisions are made.
第12段，第2句
综合来看，本句结构层次丰富且典型，既包含了高频句式框架，又融合了虚拟语气与被动语态，非常推荐作为提升句子结构拆解能力的重点训练材料。
What does the woman say is the most important thing for the man to do at first?
第13题题干
"What do you say/think is..." 属于各类英语考试听力与阅读中极常见的高频常考句型，掌握其主从跨越结构具有很高的迁移价值。
Contrary to popular belief, consumers aren't as smart as they like to believe.
第1段，第1句
该句采用 "Contrary to..., S + V + as... as..." 的标准议论文句型，在阅读与写作中高度常见且具强复用性。
A big reason is that they are driven by unconscious urges, the biggest of which is emotion.
第1段，第5句
"The reason is that..." 是阅读与写作中极高频的表达框架，配合 "the + 最高级 + of which" 的定语从句属于考试常考经典句式，迁移价值极高。
Emotion is what really drives the purchasing behaviors, and also, decision making in general.
第2段，第1句
句型结构为典型的 "名词 + be + what引导的表语从句"，属于四六级与考研阅读中极为高频的定义类句式，掌握后迁移复用价值高。

There's nothing manipulative about helping consumers achieve desired states of emotion.
第3段，第6句

They kept not only a dog but a cat.

passage.directions: Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement

content.title: The Star Quality of New Zealand's Great Barrier Island

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: I was glad I had such terrible jetlag. Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status—a typically remote area that has an "exceptional or distinguished quality of starry nights"—we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule. It's the first island and only the fourth location in the world to achieve this status.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text: After a 28-hour flight with two travel-sick children, our hearts sank when we saw the tiny twin engine 10- seater that was to take us the 90km across the Hauraki Gulf to Great Barrier Island. But we needn't have worried. Whether it was the gravity force of the plane climbing or the noise of the engine, it put our three- year-old daughter instantly to sleep until we bumped down on the grass at Claris Airport. Our first empty sick bag against all the odds…Things were looking up.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking. There are no streetlights. There are no cash machines or banks. The police force comprises a husband and wife, and there's one postman. It's not just the lack of light but the lack of noise that's so delightful on this unique and gorgeous scene. It was first discovered by East Polynesians about 700 years ago and the Maori name for the island is Aotea. Captain Cook gave the island its European name, because it acts as a barrier between the Pacific and the Hauraki Gulf.

paragraphs.label: E
paragraphs.text: The climate here is subtropical(亚热带的) like Auckland's. The island boasts a beautiful wilderness with dense forests, glorious, unspoilt sandy beaches and plenty of bays and a few mountainous areas where there are good walking tracks among the wetlands and valleys. You can birdwatch, dive, surf and boat. The best beaches are on the eastern side of the island where the surf is better, too. The sheltered western side is where you'll find the best diving and boating. Lots of people come here for the fantastic fishing spots around the island. Like a lot of spots in New Zealand, there are whale-watching trips and you might just catch sight of sharks.

paragraphs.label: F
paragraphs.text: It's rare to find an island that really does feel undiscovered—but this is it. When one of my wife's relations, who comes here regularly, found out that we'd been there, he whispered to us, only half-joking: "Shh—don't tell anyone!" The locals are a relaxed and friendly bunch—a lot of them told us that it's like what Waiheke Island (now in effect a suburb of Auckland) was in the 1970s when it was a commune of artists and people wanting to escape the city.

paragraphs.label: G
paragraphs.text: Our guide for some of our stay was the inestimable Hilde Hoven, a Dark Sky ambassador who runs Good Heavens with Deborah Kilgallon and Orla Cumisky. They bring their Dobsonian telescope and beanbags (it's hard work staring up wide-eyed in wonder without neck support) and, our elder daughter was glad to hear, hot chocolate to wherever you are on the island. "It's odd but when the light readings were done," said Hilde, explaining how the island was awarded its special status, "they found there was more light pollution on the northern side coming from Fiji, which is about 3,000km away, than Auckland to the south. It's pretty dark!"

paragraphs.label: H
paragraphs.text: Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster(星团) with white dwarf stars(白矮星), Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky. Our daughter was especially taken with Hilde's narrating of the Maori myth of Māui's fish hook to explain the shape of Scorpius. In the fable, Māui hauled the North Island of New Zealand from the bottom of the ocean with his hook.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada. Teara used to be a chef at the Langham in Auckland and so dinner, eaten around a huge circular table (made of one of the most ancient trees in the world), was every bit as mouth-watering as you'd expect. Eating pancakes on the balcony overlooking the unspoilt white sandy beach was a great way to start the day.

paragraphs.label: J
paragraphs.text: Another highlight was an hour-long walk to Kaitoke hot pools in the centre of the island, through wetlands and a forest, where we whiled away a good hour sitting in the pools shaded from the heat by layers of delicate umbrella-like plants.

paragraphs.label: K
paragraphs.text: We also loved visiting the potter(陶艺家) Sarah Harrison, who showed us round her studio at Shoal Bay harbour, and her many pots and jugs, plates and bowls and colourful mosaics(马赛克). In her work, she also uses a lot of materials found on the beach. Our elder daughter loved the gorgeous hidden pool at Medlands beach where the water is separated from the sea in a private rock pool. Other high points were the ancient pōhutukawa trees and the incredible views of Okiwi Basin and Whangapoua beach from the top of Windy Canyon, just a 10-minute hike through a narrow valley up some steep wooden steps on the eastern side of the island.

paragraphs.label: L
paragraphs.text: Apparently the island council turned down famous musician Paul McCartney's application to buy a property at Great Barrier Island because of the unwelcome attention he would have brought. You can see why he wanted to come here; equally, the island knows exactly what kind of star watching it prefers.

sentence_insights.text: S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲

24 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
A段，第2句
前置状语 + 主句 + 定语从句 + 复合时间状语从句是高考及四六级阅读理解中极其常见的长难句结构，具有极高的解构代表性与迁移价值。
We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status—a typically remote area that has an "exceptional or distinguished quality of starry nights"—we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule.
B段，第1句
“转折连词 + 时间状语从句（内含信息宾语从句）+ 主句主谓 + 宾语从句”是四六级与考研阅读真题中极具代表性的高频长难句结构。
After a 28-hour flight with two travel-sick children, our hearts sank when we saw the tiny twin engine 10-seater that was to take us the 90km across the Hauraki Gulf to Great Barrier Island.
C段，第1句
“长状语前置 + 主句 + 时间状语从句 + 定语从句”是四六级与考研阅读中极其高频的描写叙事型典型句式，迁移价值高。
But we needn't have worried.
C段，第2句
“needn't have done”是各类英语考试阅读与语法填空中的高频考点，用于表达“本不必做某事”，具备极高的典型性与迁移价值。

Whether it was the gravity force of the plane climbing or the noise of the engine, it put our three-year-old daughter instantly to sleep until we bumped down on the grass at Claris Airport.
C段，第3句
本句覆盖了“Whether... or...”让步状语从句、现在分词后置定语“plane climbing”、“put sb to sleep”的宾语补足语以及“until”时间状语从句，成分类型十分丰富，是练习句法成分拆解的优质素材。
Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking.
D段，第1句
该句“并列主句 + 主语带分词后置修饰/插入语 + 谓语后接多重介词短语”的结构在真题阅读中极具代表性，掌握其剥离修饰语找主干的方法具有很高的迁移价值。
It's not just the lack of light but the lack of noise that's so delightful on this unique and gorgeous scene.
D段，第5句
强调句型结合 "not just ... but ..." 并列连词是四六级及考研真题中的高频考点句式，掌握其去框架还原法具有极强的可迁移性。
The best beaches are on the eastern side of the island where the surf is better, too.
E段，第4句
主句 + 关系副词 "where" 引导非限制性定语从句的结构在阅读理解中非常常见，具有较高的句式迁移价值。
The sheltered western side is where you'll find the best diving and boating.
E段，第5句
“主语 + is + where从句”是英语中表示“某地是做某事的好去处”的经典常考句型，具有极高的迁移应用价值。

It's rare to find an island that really does feel undiscovered—but this is it.
F段，第1句
“It is adj. to do...”形式主语句型与“that”引导的定语从句均为四六级及考研阅读中的极高频句式，对提高句子结构拆解能力具有很强的迁移价值。
When one of my wife's relations, who comes here regularly, found out that we'd been there, he whispered to us, only half-joking: "Shh—don't tell anyone!"
F段，第2句
综合多层嵌套结构与丰富的时态语气变化，该句具有极高的结构剖析与综合训练价值，推荐优先练习。
The locals are a relaxed and friendly bunch—a lot of them told us that it's like what Waiheke Island (now in effect a suburb of Auckland) was in the 1970s when it was a commune of artists and people wanting to escape the city.
F段，第3句
虽然谓语时态相对基础，但全句的三层从句深度嵌套与丰富的成分类型使其成为剖析复杂长难句结构、提升主干与修饰剥离能力的绝佳材料，综合推荐度极高。
Our guide for some of our stay was the inestimable Hilde Hoven, a Dark Sky ambassador who runs Good Heavens with Deborah Kilgallon and Orla Cumisky.
G段，第1句
在四六级与考研阅读中，在人名后接同位语及非限制性定语从句补充背景信息的句式极为常见，具有很高的迁移复用价值。
They bring their Dobsonian telescope and beanbags (it's hard work staring up wide-eyed in wonder without neck support) and, our elder daughter was glad to hear, hot chocolate to wherever you are on the island.
G段，第2句
本句集中展示了长宾语并列、括号插入语、插入句以及介词带地点状语从句等多种常见遮挡成分，非常适合练习识别复杂主干与排除干扰成分。

"It's odd but when the light readings were done," said Hilde, explaining how the island was awarded its special status, "they found there was more light pollution on the northern side coming from Fiji, which is about 3,000km away, than Auckland to the south.
G段，第3句
综合来看，本句主干被严重遮挡且从句咬合紧密，结构典型且坑点丰富，极具长难句精读拆解与分析示范价值，应作为高优先级训练材料。
Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster(星团) with white dwarf stars(白矮星), Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
H段，第1句
“分词前置状语 + 双宾语主干 + 句末非限制性定语从句”是真题长难句中极具代表性的典范句型，迁移复用价值高。
Teara used to be a chef at the Langham in Auckland and so dinner, eaten around a huge circular table (made of one of the most ancient trees in the world), was every bit as mouth-watering as you'd expect.
I段，第2句
该句包含了主系表结构、并列连词、过去分词短语后置修饰、括号插入成分以及同级比较结构，非常适合用来训练识别长难句修饰成分与提炼主干的能力。
Another highlight was an hour-long walk to Kaitoke hot pools in the centre of the island, through wetlands and a forest, where we whiled away a good hour sitting in the pools shaded from the heat by layers of delicate umbrella-like plants.
J段，第1句
“主句 + 关系副词引出的非限制性定语从句 + 分词短语补充描写”是阅读理解与写作中极具代表性的高频句式，具有很高的迁移应用价值。

We also loved visiting the potter(陶艺家) Sarah Harrison, who showed us round her studio at Shoal Bay harbour, and her many pots and jugs, plates and bowls and colourful mosaics(马赛克).
K段，第1句
“主句 + 逗号 + who 引导的非限制性定语从句”属于英语阅读与写作中高度典型的补充说明句式，迁移复用价值高。
Apparently the island council turned down famous musician Paul McCartney's application to buy a property at Great Barrier Island because of the unwelcome attention he would have brought.
L段，第1句
“主谓宾 + 不定式定语 + because of 介词短语 + 省略引导词定语从句”的结构组合在四六级和考研真题阅读中极度高频，掌握后具备很强的迁移复用价值。
Many people are attracted to Great Barrier Island because of the incredible fishing sites around it.
第38题题干
“被动主干 + because of 介词短语表示原因”是日常阅读与写作中高频出现的典型句式，对于辨析"because" 与 "because of" 具有很强的示范迁移价值。
A well-known artist failed to purchase a house on Great Barrier Island.
第39题题干
"主语 + 动词 + 不定式短语作宾语 + 介词短语作后置修饰" 是各类英语考试阅读中极高频出现的典型单句结构，具备很强的迁移价值。
Great Barrier Island is compared to another island which attracted a lot of artists and people who wished to stay away from city life half a century ago.
第41题题干
本句是典型的“主句 + 多层嵌套定语从句”结构，在四六级与考研阅读理解中极为常见，解构方式具有很强的复用性。

content.passage: Is organic food worth the higher price? It's the classic grocery store dilemma. On the one hand, your family dinner table deserves only the best. On the other hand, your wallet can only stretch so far. Whether or not to buy organic is a personal decision, said Mike von Massow, professor of Food Agriculture. Science won't give a clear-cut answer to the question of whether organic food is "better". There are often trade-offs(权衡) and answers become less definitive depending on the product under consideration. One thing is definitive: Organic and conventionally grown food are equally nutritious. From a nutrition point of view, there is no difference between organic and traditionally grown products. Organic products don't necessarily have fewer pesticides(杀虫剂)—in fact, they may have more. There is also no big difference between organic and non-organic products from a food-safety perspective. Even organic growers use pesticides. Testing shows little if any pesticide remains on conventionally grown products. In fact, organic farmers often use larger quantities of pesticide because they can only use the natural variety of insect-killers. Chemical pesticides generally kill a much wider range of pests(害虫) than any single natural pesticide. The use of animal waste in organic agriculture can also be a factor in the spread of bacteria like E. coli and salmonella. Over the past 10 years, Canada has seen more food-safety recalls for organic products, proportionally, than for conventional products. On the whole, organic agriculture may have a smaller environmental footprint. That's mostly because the risk of groundwater contamination from organic farming is lower. Organic farmers never use neonics, the controversial pesticides that have been linked to shrinking bee populations worldwide. Traditional agriculture has been making "dramatic improvements" to reduce its impact on the environment. It isn't a black-and-white picture, though. Organic farming is much less efficient when it comes to land use, although yields vary considerably depending on the crop. On the other hand, advocates of organic farming argue yields and efficiency could be significantly improved if the food industry devoted as much research and money to organic farming as it does conventional agriculture. Directions: There are 2 passages in this section. Each passage is followed by some questions or

Passage One
P1 Is organic food worth the higher price? It's the classic grocery store dilemma. On the one hand,
your family dinner table deserves only the best. On the other hand, your wallet can only stretch so far.

之间没有差别。

P5 Organic products don't necessarily have fewer pesticides(杀虫剂)—in fact, they may have more.
There is also no big difference between organic and non-organic products from a food-safety perspective.
Even organic growers use pesticides. Testing shows little if any pesticide remains on conventionally
grown products.
有机产品未必含有更少的杀虫剂，事实上，它们所使用的杀虫剂可能更多。从食品安全角度看，有机产品
与非有机产品之间也没有很大差别。即使是有机种植者也会使用杀虫剂。检测表明，常规种植的产品上残
留的杀虫剂即使有，也非常少。
P6 In fact, organic farmers often use larger quantities of pesticide because they can only use the
natural variety of insect-killers. Chemical pesticides generally kill a much wider range of pests(害虫)

在有机农业中使用动物排泄物，也可能成为大肠杆菌和沙门氏菌等细菌传播的一个因素。在过去10年里，
加拿大有机产品被召回的食品安全事件占比高于常规产品。
P8 On the whole, organic agriculture may have a smaller environmental footprint. That's mostly
because the risk of groundwater contamination from organic farming is lower. Organic farmers never use
neonics, the controversial pesticides that have been linked to shrinking bee populations worldwide.
总体而言，有机农业对环境的影响可能较小。这主要是因为有机农业造成地下水污染的风险较低。有机农
民从不使用新烟碱类农药，而这种备受争议的杀虫剂一直被认为与全球蜜蜂数量减少有关。

environment.
传统农业一直在进行“显著的改进”，以减少其对环境的影响。

不过，情况并非非黑即白。

considerably depending on the crop.
在土地利用方面，有机农业的效率低得多，尽管产量会因作物不同而有很大差异。
P12 On the other hand, advocates of organic farming argue yields and efficiency could be
significantly improved if the food industry devoted as much research and money to organic farming as it
does conventional agriculture.
另一方面，有机农业的支持者认为，如果食品行业像投入常规农业那样投入同等多的研究和资金用于有机
农业，那么产量和效率就可能得到显著提高。
题目与逐题解析
经典的杂货店困境是什么？
A) 是否应该吃有机食品。
B) 一个人是否能让自己的钱包撑得住。
C) 有机食品价格更高，但味道确实更好。
D) 一个人想要最好的食物，但预算有限。
【答案】D （细节题）
【判型】What is the classic grocery store dilemma? 没有 infer/suggest/imply 等推断标记，而
是直接询问文中某一表述指什么。
【拆句】What is the classic grocery store dilemma? 是一个简单的主系表疑问句，主干为 What
is the dilemma，无否定、比较或从句陷阱。
【定位】On the one hand, your family dinner table deserves only the best. On the other hand, your
wallet can only stretch so far.
一方面，你家餐桌上的人只配吃最好的；另一方面，你的钱包只能撑到这么多。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
A 项说'是否应该吃有机食品'，这是文章讨论的大话题，而非 the classic grocery store
dilemma 所指的具体两难处境。
B)
以偏概全
B 项只提到'钱包能撑多远'，把原文预算受限的一面单独拿出来，却丢掉了'想要最好的食
物'这一面，不能完整解释 dilemma。
C)
无中生有
C 项说有机食品'当然更好吃'，但原文 P1 只提到' deserves only the best'，并未说明
best 指味道，更无 certainly tastes better 的依据。
D)
✓ 正确
your family dinner table deserves only the best ↔One wants the best food
your wallet can only stretch so far ↔their budget is limited
D 项把 On the one hand ... On the other hand ... 的两侧都概括进去，既提到'想要最
好的食物'，也提到'预算有限'。

content.passage: It is still controversial whether we are fundamentally generous or selfish and whether these tendencies are shaped by our genes or environment. Some evidence points to humans being born cooperative. At later stages in life we routinely work together to reach goals and help out in times of need. Yet instances of selfish behavior are also plenty. One recent study tested people's willingness to set aside selfish interests to reach a greater good. It found that being selfish was more advantageous than cooperating. The benefit may be short-lived, however. Another study showed that players who cooperated did better in the long run. It seems that human nature supports both pro-social and selfish traits(特征). Genetic studies have made some progress toward identifying their biological roots. By comparing identical twins, who share nearly 100 percent of their genes, and non-identical twins, who share about half, researchers have found overwhelming evidence for genetic effects on behaviors. In these twin studies, identical and non-identical twins are asked, for example, to split a sum of money with a peer. Such studies often also rely on careful psychological assessments and DNA analysis. Other work highlights specific genes as key players. My colleagues and I recently identified a gene linked to altruistic(利他的) behavior and found that a particular variant of it was associated with more selfish behavior in preschoolers. According to evolutionary scientists, cooperative behavior may have evolved first among relatives to promote the continuation of their genetic line. As communities diversified, mutual support could have broadened to include individuals not linked by blood. Another possibility is that humans cooperate to gain some advantage, such as boosting reputation. Finally, evolutionary processes take place at the group level. Groups of highly cooperative individuals have higher chances of survival because they can work together to reach goals that are unattainable to less cooperative groups. Yet almost no behavior is entirely genetic, even among identical twins. Culture, schooling and parenting are important determinants of cooperation. Thus, the degree to which we act cooperatively or selfishly is unique to each individual and depends on a variety of genetic and environmental influences. Part Ⅲ Section C (2)
Directions: There are 2 passages in this section. Each passage is followed by some questions or
unfinished statements. For each of them there are four choices marked A), B), C) and D). You should
decide on the best choice and mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line
through the centre.
Passage Two
P1 It is still controversial whether we are fundamentally generous or selfish and whether these
tendencies are shaped by our genes or environment.
关于我们从根本上说是慷慨还是自私，以及这些倾向是由我们的基因还是环境塑造的，目前仍存在争议。
P2 Some evidence points to humans being born cooperative. At later stages in life we routinely
work together to reach goals and help out in times of need.
一些证据表明，人类生来就具有合作倾向。在生命的后期阶段，我们通常会共同努力实现目标，并在他人
有需要时提供帮助。
P3 Yet instances of selfish behavior are also plenty. One recent study tested people's willingness to
set aside selfish interests to reach a greater good. It found that being selfish was more advantageous than
cooperating. The benefit may be short-lived, however. Another study showed that players who cooperated
did better in the long run.
然而，自私行为的例子也比比皆是。最近的一项研究测试了人们为了实现更大的共同利益而搁置自私利益
的意愿。研究发现，自私比合作更有利。不过，这种好处可能是短暂的。另一项研究表明，从长远来看，
进行合作的参与者表现得更好。
P4 It seems that human nature supports both pro-social and selfish traits(特征). Genetic studies have
made some progress toward identifying their biological roots. By comparing identical twins, who share
nearly 100 percent of their genes, and non-identical twins, who share about half, researchers have found
Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.
overwhelming evidence for genetic effects on behaviors. In these twin studies, identical and non-identical
twins are asked, for example, to split a sum of money with a peer. Such studies often also rely on
careful psychological assessments and DNA analysis.
看来，人性同时支持亲社会特征和自私特征。遗传学研究已经在确定这些特征的生物学根源方面取得了一
些进展。通过比较基因几乎百分之百相同的同卵双胞胎和基因约有一半相同的异卵双胞胎，研究人员发现
了行为受遗传因素影响的压倒性证据。在这些双胞胎研究中，研究人员会要求同卵双胞胎和异卵双胞胎，
例如，将一笔钱分给一名同伴。这类研究通常还依赖于严谨的心理评估和DNA分析。
P5 Other work highlights specific genes as key players. My colleagues and I recently identified a
gene linked to altruistic(利他的) behavior and found that a particular variant of it was associated with
more selfish behavior in preschoolers.
其他研究则强调了某些具体基因所发挥的关键作用。我的同事和我最近发现了一个与利他行为有关的基
因，并发现该基因的某一特定变体与学龄前儿童更自私的行为有关。
P6 According to evolutionary scientists, cooperative behavior may have evolved first among
relatives to promote the continuation of their genetic line. As communities diversified, mutual support
could have broadened to include individuals not linked by blood. Another possibility is that humans
cooperate to gain some advantage, such as boosting reputation. Finally, evolutionary processes take place
at the group level. Groups of highly cooperative individuals have higher chances of survival because they
can work together to reach goals that are unattainable to less cooperative groups.
根据进化科学家的观点，合作行为可能首先在亲属之间进化出来，以促进其遗传谱系的延续。随着群体日
益多样化，相互支持可能扩大到包括没有血缘关系的个体。另一种可能性是，人类通过合作来获得某种优
势，例如提升声誉。最后，进化过程也会发生在群体层面。高度合作的个体组成的群体具有更高的生存机
会，因为他们能够共同实现那些合作程度较低的群体无法实现的目标。
P7 Yet almost no behavior is entirely genetic, even among identical twins. Culture, schooling and
parenting are important determinants of cooperation. Thus, the degree to which we act cooperatively or
selfishly is unique to each individual and depends on a variety of genetic and environmental influences.
然而，几乎没有任何行为完全由遗传决定，即使是在同卵双胞胎之间也是如此。文化、学校教育和父母养
育方式都是影响合作的重要因素。因此，我们表现得合作或自私的程度因人而异，并取决于多种遗传和环
境因素的影响。
题目与逐题解析
最近一项关于自私行为的研究发现了什么？
A) 短期内可能带来某些好处。
B) 通常弊大于利。
C) 满足个人利益而非集体利益。
D) 长期来看可能让位于合作。
【答案】A （细节题）

Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You
should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道
理。在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985
年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。尊师是中华民族的传统

content.reference_translation:
There is an old Chinese saying: "A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime." In the eyes of
Chinese people, teachers not only impart knowledge, but also teach students how to be a good person. In
ancient times, students had to hold a grand ceremony when they met their teacher for the first time,
which was enough to show the high status of teachers. To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting
teachers, China has observed September 10 of each year as Teachers' Day since 1985. On this day,
students express their respect for teachers in various ways. Respecting teachers is a traditional virtue of
the Chinese nation, and it has been carried forward in today's society.
content.sentence_notes:
逐句解析
本页整篇参考英译与逐句解析由公开资料基于2026年6月·第1套 英语四级汉译英（段落翻译）原卷题干译审整理。与试卷排版同一卷面：Directions 与一整段中文原文连续排印——整段连排、无段落标记无题号，把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作。卷面之后先给整篇参考英译定稿，再按自切句序逐句拆分：定英文主干、降级修饰成分、逐项落实语法点、句内定稿英译，答案直显。
Part IV
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理。在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。尊师是中华民族的传统美德，在当今社会得到了发扬光大。
参考译文
整篇参考英译是复盘资产，考卷上只印中文原文——四六级 Part IV 翻译按整篇「表达通顺连贯、用词准确、语法正确」四档评分。
There is an old Chinese saying: "A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime." In the eyes of Chinese people, teachers not only impart knowledge, but also teach students how to be a good person. In ancient times, students had to hold a grand ceremony when they met their teacher for the first time, which was enough to show the high status of teachers. To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers, China has observed September 10 of each year as Teachers' Day since 1985. On this day, students express their respect for teachers in various ways. Respecting teachers is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, and it has been carried forward in today's society.
【衔接】第4句与第5句之间：用 On this day 回指教师节
第4句末刚出现 Teachers' Day，第5句 在这一天 直接译 On this day 放句首，天然形成回指衔接，不必重复 September 10 或 the festival——英文靠 this 这类指示词勾连上下文，考生要有意识地让「这／那／其」落到 this/that/these 上。
第6句内部：用 it 承接 Respecting teachers
第6句前后两半共享主语 尊师，后半句不再重复 Respecting teachers，改用 and it has been carried forward…，代词 it 承接前文的动名词短语，避免同一主语两遍造成的臃肿。
第3句与第4句之间：古今顺序即逻辑
在古代 与 从1985年开始 构成从古到今的时间线，英文 In ancient times…／To carry forward…, China has…since 1985 按原顺序排列即可，时间词本身承担衔接功能，无需硬加 And then；强行加连接词反而生硬。
逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。
【主旨】介绍中国尊师传统与教师节由来的文化说明文
全段围绕「尊师」展开：先引谚语 一日为师，终身为父 立观点，再讲 在中国人的观念里 老师的角色、古代拜师礼，最后落到 定为教师节 与当今现实。这是四级汉译英最典型的中国文化介绍类语体：客观陈述事实与传统，用词平实正式，不需要口语化或文学化表达。
【时态】一般现在时
通篇在客观介绍一种至今仍成立的观念与习俗——老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理、学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意 说的都是常态事实，故全篇以一般现在时为默认时态。仅两处确有需要才偏离：在古代 指过去→用一般过去时；从1985年开始 持续到现在→用现在完成时。
【译法】教师节
统一译作 Teachers' Day：约定俗成的法定节日译名，注意是复数 teachers 加撇号的所有格（不是Teacher's Day，也不是 Teachers Day），Day 大写。全篇 教师节 只用这一种写法。
尊师
统一译作 respecting teachers（动名词短语，意译）：为弘扬尊师的优良传统 里作定语，用 of respecting teachers；尊师是中华民族的传统美德 里作主语，直接用 Respecting teachers。同一个文化词全篇保持同一译法，避免一处 respect teachers、一处 honoring teachers 混用。
中华民族
统一译作 the Chinese nation：约定俗成译名，尊师是中华民族的传统美德 中「的」译为 of 短语a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation。
1. 中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。
【主干】There is an old Chinese saying 引出谚语（主语策略：There be）
中国有句老话 不是说「中国拥有话」，而是说「（在中国）存在一句老话」——表存在，英文最地道的骨架是 There be 句型：There is（谓语）an old Chinese saying（真主语）。冒号后的谚语一日为师，终身为父 作为 saying 的内容直接接在后面。
【降级】引语整体作同位内容，无需拆解
一日为师，终身为父 是 saying 的具体内容，英文惯例是冒号后直接接引号原文，相当于同位语，不需要另造从句。谚语本身内部「一日／终身」对仗，译成 A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime，用 for a day / for a lifetime 两个介词短语保住对仗感，而不是逐字硬译 one day be teacher。
【语法】时态
回指全篇基调用一般现在时：谚语是超越时间的常理，There is、is 都用现在时；千万不要因为「老话」听起来古老就用过去时 There was——谚语讲道理永远用现在时。
冠词
saying 是可数名词单数且首次出现、非特指→前面加 an（old 元音开头）：an old Chinese saying；谚语内部 a teacher / a father 均为泛指「任何一个」，用不定冠词 a。
单复数
「一日为师，终身为父」讲的是任何一个个体的情形，a teacher、a father、a lifetime 都用单数；考生易顺手写成 teachers/fathers 复数，反而破坏对仗。
【译文】There is an old Chinese saying: "A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime."
2. 在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理。
【主干】teachers not only impart…but also teach…（主语策略：原句主语）
中文主语明确：老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理 中做动作的是「老师」→主语teachers（泛指教师这一类人，用复数）；核心动词有两个「传授」「教给」，由「不仅……更……」并列为共同谓语：not only impart knowledge, but also teach students…，宾语分别是knowledge 和 students。
【降级】「在中国人的观念里」降为介词短语，「做人的道理」译为不定式短语
在中国人的观念里 是范围状语，降级为句首介词短语 In the eyes of Chinese people，不要另起In Chinese people's concept is… 这种残句；做人的道理 是「教给学生」的内容，译成 how to be a good person（疑问词+不定式作宾语），比 the principles of being a person 更口语地道且不易写错。
【语法】时态
回指全篇基调用一般现在时：老师不仅传授知识 说的是教师这一角色的常态职责，impart / teach用原形。
主谓一致
主语 teachers 为复数泛指，谓语 impart、teach 均用动词原形，不能加 -s；考生常受「老师」中文无单复数影响，随手写成 the teacher imparts，与后文 students 复数搭配失衡。
单复数
「老师」「学生」都是泛指一类人→teachers、students 复数且不加 the（复数泛指表类别时前面裸奔）；knowledge 是不可数名词，绝不能写成 knowledges。
【译文】In the eyes of Chinese people, teachers not only impart knowledge, but also teach students how to be a good person.
3. 在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。
【主干】students had to hold a grand ceremony（主语策略：原句主语）
主干取自 学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式：做动作的是「学生」→主语 students；核心动词「举行」→谓语 hold（「要」表必须，译为情态化的 had to hold）；宾语 a grand ceremony。后半句 足见老师地位之高 不另立主干，留给降级处理。
【降级】「初次见老师时」降为时间状语从句，「足见……」降为which非限定定语从句
「初次见老师时」→ when they met their teacher for the first time，作时间状语挂在主干后；足见老师地位之高 是对整件事的评论，英文惯用 which 引导的非限定定语从句承接：which was enough to show the high status of teachers（which 指代前面整件事）。「地位之高」这个「之」字结构不要硬译成 so high status，转写为名词短语 the high status of teachers 或宾语从句 how high teachers' status was。
【语法】时态
本句是全篇基调的第一处正当偏离：在古代 明确指过去，主从句都切一般过去时——had to hold、met、was enough to show。考生最易犯的错就是沿用上句的现在时 hold，时间词出现在句首时必须警觉。
主谓一致
when 从句主语 they 指代 students，谓语 met 用过去式与主句一致；which 从句的 be 动词跟前面整件事（单数概念）→用 was。
单复数与冠词
ceremony 可数，「一场隆重的仪式」→a grand ceremony；their teacher 指每个学生拜的那一位老师，用单数即可；status 此处不可数，the high status 不加 -s。
【译文】In ancient times, students had to hold a grand ceremony when they met their teacher for the first time, which was enough to show the high status of teachers.
4. 为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。
【主干】China has observed September 10 as Teachers' Day（主语策略：原句主语）
主干取自 中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节：动作发出者是「中国」→主语 China；核心动作「（定为／把……当作节日来过）」→谓语 has observed（observe a day＝过某个纪念日，可延续，配 since 1985）；宾语 September 10，as Teachers' Day 作宾语补足语。「每年的」→ of each year 作后置定语。
【降级】「为弘扬……」降为不定式目的状语，「从1985年开始」降为since短语
为弘扬尊师的优良传统 表目的，降级为句首不定式 To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers（「尊师」按全局词表统一用 respecting teachers，「弘扬」用 carry forward，比 promote 更贴「优良传统」）；从1985年开始 降级为句尾介词短语 since 1985，不要译成 from 1985 began 这种中式结构。
【语法】时态
从1985年开始＝从过去持续到现在→用现在完成时 has observed，这是全篇基调的第二处正当偏离。注意动词必须可持续：observe／celebrate 年年重复成立；若用 designate（一次性指定）就得改成 In 1985, China designated… 一般过去时，二者只能选一套，不能写成 has designated…since 1985。
主谓一致
主语 China 是单数国家名→助动词用 has，不是 have。
专有名词写法
教师节 按词表统一写 Teachers' Day：复数 teachers＋撇号，Day 大写；September 10 月份首字母大写。这是阅卷一眼可见的拼写硬伤点。
【译文】To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers, China has observed September 10 of each year as Teachers' Day since 1985.
5. 在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。
【主干】students express their respect（主语策略：原句主语）
学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意 主语明确是「学生」→students；核心动词「表达」→express；宾语「敬意」→their respect（respect 表「敬意」时不可数）。这是典型的主谓宾简单句骨架。
【降级】「在这一天」「以各种方式」都降为介词短语，「对老师的」用for引出

Directions: Suppose it is proposed that university students should be required to participate in at least one
research project. You are now to write a response by stating what you think of the proposal in terms of its
necessity and practicality. You will have 30 minutes to write the response. You should write at least 120 words
but not more than 180 words.
content.model_essay:
Requiring university students to take part in at least one research project is a proposal worth supporting,
provided it is implemented flexibly and students can choose topics that interest them. From my perspective,
such a policy is both necessary and practical for most undergraduates.
First, it is necessary because research experience bridges the gap between textbook knowledge and real-world
problem solving. Through a well-designed project, students learn to ask meaningful questions, collect reliable
data, and think critically. These abilities are essential for their future careers. Second, it is practical because
universities already have laboratories, supervisors, and course projects in place. A single semester-long project
can fit into the existing curriculum without placing too much burden on students.
Therefore, I support the proposal. It helps students develop practical skills that lectures alone cannot provide,
and its flexible design makes it achievable for most universities.
content.model_essay_cn:
要求大学生至少参与一项科研项目是一项值得支持的提案，前提是其能灵活实施，学生也能选择自己感兴
趣的课题。在我看来，这项政策对大多数本科生而言既有必要又切实可行。
首先，它很有必要，因为科研经历能够弥合课本知识与现实问题解决之间的鸿沟。通过一个设计良好的项
目，学生学习提出有意义的问题、收集可靠的数据并进行批判性思考。这些能力对他们未来的职业生涯至
关重要。其次，它也很可行，因为高校已经拥有实验室、指导教师和课程项目等资源。一个为期一学期的
项目可以嵌入现有课程体系，不会给学生造成过重负担。
因此，我支持这一提案。它帮助学生培养课堂讲授无法提供的实践技能，而灵活的设计也让大多数高校能
够落实。

同义转述+明确立场。首句用 Requiring university students to take part in... 转述了提案内容，避免机械照抄；第二句用 both necessary and practical 直接点出两个论证维度。

分论点+例子支撑。用 First/Second 分别对应必要性与可行性，每个论点都给出具体理由（bridges the gap / universities already have...in place），并加入 well-designed project 等具体场景。

重申立场并收束。用 Therefore 回扣开头立场，用 practical skills that lectures alone cannot provide 总结双重价值，避免提出新观点。

Two proposals are before the state legislature that look to put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices, which some lawmakers say are contributing to rising homelessness rates.

The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from raising rent more than the rate of inflation in most cases. There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old, public housing, improvements beyond maintenance, and a hardship __(27)__ .

In a 2020 study, researchers at the U.S. Government Accountability Office estimated that every $100 in rent increase is __(28)__ to a 9% rise in homelessness. Rent increases have an even more detrimental effect on some demographic groups, such as racial minorities.

Representative Alex Ramel explained why he thought that this kind of legislation was so important, telling the story of a __(29)__ struggling to live in the community.

Ramel pointed out the __(30)__ effect of double-digit rent increases, saying that he made the decision to introduce the legislation while talking to a young man in Bellingham. "He's a recent graduate from Western Washington University and just got a new job," Ramel said. "He was leaving our community because his landlord __(31)__ him that his rent was going to go up by $600 a month."

The Rental Housing Association of Washington opposes the legislation. The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices. Instead, it will punish small landlords and allow wealthy renters easy access to cheap housing.

"The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county. It has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__ . It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when __(35)__ who gets the benefits of rent control," said Chester Baldwin with the Rental Housing Coalition.
