main.directions: Directions: In this section, you will hear two long conversations. At the end of each conversation, you will hear

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Welcome to "Business Matters". Today we have invited career development consultant Lucy Williams to talk about how to get ahead at work. Hi, Lucy. Many of us never seem to get promoted. Why is that? And what can we do about it?
lines.cn: M: 欢迎收听《商业纵横》。今天我们邀请了职业发展顾问露西·威廉姆斯，来谈谈如何在职场上取得成功。你好，露西。我们很多人似乎一直得不到晋升，这是为什么？我们又能做些什么呢？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: One mistake people make is to limit communication only to their bosses. It's important to expand your network and include your co-workers.
lines.cn: W: 人们常犯的一个错误，是把沟通对象局限在自己的上司。拓展人际网络很重要，也要把同事纳入其中。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: But some of our co-workers are less senior to us. Is it really necessary to connect with them?
lines.cn: M: 但我们有些同事的职位比我们低。真的有必要和他们建立联系吗？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: It's important not to underestimate your colleagues. Sometimes a job title might not clearly demonstrate the influence they may have.
lines.cn: W: 重要的是不要低估你的同事。有时候，职位名称并不能清楚地体现他们可能拥有的影响力。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Now many of us think that working hard creates a good impression, but this isn't always true, is it?
lines.cn: M: 现在我们很多人都认为努力工作会给别人留下好印象，但事实并不总是如此，对吧？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: That's right. We should avoid trying to take on too much work and constantly staying late, just to show that you are committed.
lines.cn: W: 没错。我们应该避免为了表现出自己的投入，就试图承担过多的工作，还总是加班到很晚。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: I see. So setting expectations too high at the beginning can make us look bad if we don't maintain them.
lines.cn: M: 我明白了。所以，一开始就把别人对我们的期待设得太高，如果后来无法保持，就可能让我们看起来很糟糕。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Yeah, it's better to make sure you are putting in quality time instead of just a large quantity of time. And these efforts can easily be demonstrated by the results we achieve.
lines.cn: W: 是的，最好确保自己投入的是高质量的时间，而不只是大量的时间。而且，我们取得的成果很容易证明这些努力。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: What about helping others at work? Should you try and go beyond your normal responsibilities and offer to help people with their projects?
lines.cn: M: 那么，在工作中帮助别人呢？你是否应该尽力超越自己的日常职责，主动提出帮助别人完成项目？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Extend your assistance to those who need it, but only as long as your own work will not go unattended. If someone can benefit from your assistance or advice, help them out to gain their respect and trust.
lines.cn: W: 向那些需要帮助的人提供援助，但前提是不能让自己的工作无人处理。如果有人能从你的帮助或建议中获益，就帮他们一把，以赢得他们的尊重和信任。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: But it goes without saying that you shouldn't act like a know-it-all, otherwise you'll appear arrogant.
lines.cn: M: 不过，显而易见，你不应该表现得像个无所不知的人，否则会显得傲慢。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: Absolutely. Be humble, and you'll get a lot of time later on to show your genius.
lines.cn: W: 当然。保持谦逊，之后你会有很多时间展现自己的才华。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: I think we first need to decide how to divide up the presentation responsibilities. From what I recall, the presentation consists of five parts, not including the introduction and conclusion. That would mean altogether, we need to allocate seven parts between the two of us.
lines.cn: W: 我觉得我们首先需要决定如何分配演示的任务。据我所记得，这次演示由五个部分组成，不包括开头和结尾。也就是说，我们总共需要在我们两个人之间分配七个部分。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: So, we have the abstract, background research, the project design, the results and the discussion portions. As the abstract section only applies to the article, we needn't include it in the presentation. How would you suggest we dole out the rest?
lines.cn: M: 所以，我们有摘要、背景研究、项目设计、结果和讨论这几个部分。由于摘要部分只适用于文章，我们不必把它包括在演示中。你建议我们如何分配剩下的部分？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: How do you feel about handling the background bit? In this way, we can both discuss the part of the project that we devoted most of our time to.
lines.cn: W: 你觉得由你来负责背景研究部分怎么样？这样一来，我们就都可以讲述自己投入最多时间的项目部分了。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: Hold on a minute. You want me, the one who did the bulk of the task, to also do the majority of the presentation? The background research which was so meticulous took more than a month.
lines.cn: M: 等一下。你是想让我这个承担了大部分任务的人，再负责演示的大部分内容？那份一丝不苟的背景研究花了一个多月的时间。

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: OK. OK. I get it. Quit your moaning. I appreciate the rigorous work ethic you applied to the research, but not the sarcasm that comes up every time I mention it. What do you think would be a fair arrangement?
lines.cn: W: 好了，好了。我明白了。别再抱怨了。我认可你在研究中所表现出的严谨工作态度，但不欣赏每次我提到这件事时你表现出的讽刺。你觉得怎样分配才公平？

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: I think the best arrangement would be to split the research into two parts: before-1980 and afterward. I would take the before-portion and you would be assigned the after-1980, leaving the project and results. I volunteer to describe the project. But as I struggled a bit with the statistics in the results section, how about you handling that?
lines.cn: M: 我觉得最好的安排是把研究分成两部分：1980年以前和之后。我负责1980年以前的部分，你负责1980年以后的部分，项目设计和结果部分则另行分配。我自愿介绍项目设计。不过，我在结果部分的统计数据方面有些吃力，你来负责那一部分怎么样？

lines.speaker: W
lines.en: That's agreeable to me. I propose we both handle the discussion section in parts along with the question and answer afterward, leaving only the introduction and conclusion.
lines.cn: W: 我觉得这样可以。我提议我们分段负责讨论部分，之后的问答环节也由我们共同完成，这样就只剩下开头和结尾了。

lines.speaker: M
lines.en: I will take responsibility for the conclusion and put you in charge of the introduction. This will make it so that we alternate presenting, so as to avoid sounding monotonous to the audience.
lines.cn: M: 我来负责结尾，你来负责开头。这样我们就可以交替进行演示，避免让听众觉得单调。

lines.en: Makeup can do more than just change your appearance—it can also alter others' perceptions of you, for better or for worse. According to new research from the University of Stirling in Scotland, although both men and women perceive women who wear makeup as being of a higher status, men associate makeup with prestigious, positive qualities, while women view other women wearing makeup as being dominant and a potential threat.
lines.cn: 化妆不仅能改变你的外表，还能改变他人对你的看法，结果可能更好，也可能更糟。根据苏格兰斯特灵大学的一项新研究，虽然男性和女性都认为化妆的女性地位更高，但男性会将化妆与有声望、积极的品质联系起来，而女性则认为化妆的其他女性更具支配性，并可能构成威胁。

lines.en: The research showed that men and women both rated the faces with cosmetics as being more attractive, but only women rated made-up faces as being more dominant, while only men rated made-up faces as being higher in prestige.
lines.cn: 研究表明，男性和女性都认为化妆后的面孔更具吸引力，但只有女性认为化妆后的面孔更具支配性，只有男性认为化妆后的面孔具有更高的声望。

lines.en: A follow-up study investigated the root cause behind these differences in perception, and found that female-on-female jealousy seemed to be the main cause of the differences in perception. Women rating women with makeup said they would be more jealous of them and thought they would be more attractive to men than their non-makeup wearing counterparts.
lines.cn: 一项后续研究探究了这些认知差异背后的根本原因，发现女性之间的嫉妒似乎是造成这种认知差异的主要原因。对化妆女性进行评价的女性表示，她们会更嫉妒这些女性，并认为相比不化妆的女性，她们对男性更具吸引力。

lines.en: Cosmetic products are good for more than just giving you a pretty face. It can be particularly useful for women to understand how wearing makeup alters others' perceptions of them in situations where they are trying to gain others' trust and admiration. At a job interview, knowing whether the hiring committee will consist of men or women might influence a female candidate's decision about wearing makeup. Whether the interviewers will view her as attractive, dominant and prestigious can affect the interviewers' actions and perhaps the outcome of the interview itself.
lines.cn: 化妆品的作用不只是让你拥有一张漂亮的脸。对于女性而言，了解化妆如何改变他人对自己的看法，尤其是在试图赢得他人的信任和钦佩时，可能非常有用。在求职面试中，了解招聘委员会由男性还是女性组成，可能会影响女性求职者是否化妆的决定。面试官是否会认为她具有吸引力、支配性和声望，可能会影响面试官的行为，甚至可能影响面试本身的结果。

lines.en: You may have seen advertisements trumpeting methods of changing a habit that require absolutely no willpower whatsoever. But can you really change a bad habit or create a good one without willpower? To answer this question, we first have to ask: "What is willpower?" Most people, sadly, think of it only as the ability to clench their teeth and resist attractive temptations. In this view, willpower means self- denial and no fun. No wonder people hope to make changes without it.
lines.cn: 你可能见过一些广告大肆宣扬无需任何意志力就能改变习惯的方法。但你真的能够在没有意志力的情况下改掉坏习惯或养成好习惯吗？要回答这个问题，我们首先必须问：“什么是意志力？”遗憾的是，大多数人只把它看作咬紧牙关、抵制诱人诱惑的能力。在这种看法中，意志力意味着自我克制和毫无乐趣。难怪人们希望不借助意志力就能做出改变。

lines.en: I define willpower as "using only the thought of your motivators to control your actions." Let's say your motivators are "prevent diabetes" and "reach a healthy weight". So if you are at the all-you-can-eat buffet, you think about your motivator—avoid diabetes through weight loss—and you take small portions and avoid the dessert table.
lines.cn: 我把意志力定义为“仅凭想到自己的动机来控制行为”。假设你的动机是“预防糖尿病”和“达到健康体重”。那么，当你在自助餐厅面对不限量供应的食物时，你会想到自己的动机——通过减重来避免糖尿病——于是少量取食，并避开甜点区。

lines.en: So, amazingly enough, willpower begins with a thought—a bright idea—some way to improve your life or contribute to others. This bright idea is your motivator.
lines.cn: 所以，令人惊讶的是，意志力始于一个想法——一个改善生活或为他人做出贡献的好主意。这个好主意就是你的动机。

lines.en: Doctor Walter Mischel, an expert on willpower skills, uses the expressive term "a burning goal". Whether you call it a motivator, a burning goal, or a bright idea, this idea is the force behind your willpower.
lines.cn: 意志力技能专家沃尔特·米歇尔博士使用了“一个燃烧的目标”这一生动的说法。无论你把它称为动机、燃烧的目标，还是好主意，这个想法都是意志力背后的力量。

lines.en: What sort of bright ideas—motivators—make for effective willpower? In fact, any goal that you value strongly counts. The list may include good health, self-respect, a better future for your family, a personal mission and being a role model for your child. All these can certainly drive a positive change.
lines.cn: 什么样的好主意——也就是动机——能够产生有效的意志力？事实上，任何一个你高度重视的目标都算在内。这个清单可能包括良好的健康状况、自尊、为家人创造更美好的未来、个人使命，以及成为孩子的榜样。所有这些都确实能够推动积极的改变。

lines.en: For many pregnant women, understanding what seafood is safe and healthy and what should be avoided because of mercury concerns comes with a lot of worrying. In part, that's because the federal government's advice on the matter, first issued in 2004, has long been criticized as vague. That guidance has included advice on how much seafood to eat, and which species pregnant and breastfeeding women should avoid over concerns about mercury contamination. But critics say the government advisory has done more harm than good, scaring many pregnant and breastfeeding women away from eating seafood altogether.
lines.cn: 对许多孕妇来说，了解哪些海产品安全且有益健康，以及哪些海产品因担心汞而应当避免，会带来许多忧虑。部分原因在于，联邦政府首次于2004年发布的相关建议长期以来一直被批评含糊不清。该指导意见包括关于应食用多少海产品，以及孕妇和哺乳期女性因担心汞污染而应避免哪些种类的建议。但批评者表示，政府的这份指导意见弊大于利，使许多孕妇和哺乳期女性彻底不敢食用海产品。

lines.en: The problem is real. According to a spokesman for the Food and Drug Administration, or FDA for short, the agency analyzed fish consumption data from more than 1,000 pregnant women in the US and found that 21 per cent of them ate no fish whatsoever in the previous month. And those who did eat fish consumed far less than recommended by the dietary guidelines. Some 50 per cent ate less than two ounces a week and 75 per cent ate less than four ounces.
lines.cn: 这个问题确实存在。据美国食品药品监督管理局（简称FDA）一位发言人介绍，该机构分析了美国一千多名孕妇的鱼类食用数据，发现其中21%在前一个月完全没有吃鱼。而那些吃鱼的人，摄入量也远低于膳食指南的建议。约50%的人每周摄入量少于两盎司，75%的人少于四盎司。

lines.en: This week the FDA issued an update to the advice, listing more than sixty species in a chart that ranks fish as A Best Choice, Good Choice and Choices to Avoid. The goal is to make it easier for mothers-to-be to feel confident about the type of seafood they include in their diets. The new advice recommends consumers choose a variety of fish to eat, and it comes with an easy-to-understand illustration of what an appropriate portion size should be—four ounces for an adult and two ounces for children aged four to seven.
lines.cn: 本周，FDA更新了相关建议，在一张图表中列出六十多种鱼类，并将其分为“最佳选择”“不错的选择”和“应避免的选择”。此举旨在让准妈妈更容易对自己饮食中所摄入的海产品种类感到放心。新建议推荐消费者食用多种鱼类，并配有一幅易于理解的图示，说明适当的食用分量应为多少：成年人四盎司，四至七岁的儿童两盎司。

lines.en: And while expectant mothers have long been warned to stay away from shark and four other particular types of fish from the Gulf of Mexico, now there are three new species on the list of what to avoid. But not everyone is thrilled with the new advice. Critics say the new advice doesn't always agree with the agency's own scientific findings. While mercury is of great concern when people are talking about pregnant women and seafood, it's not the only factor contributing to anxiety.
lines.cn: 长期以来，准妈妈一直被告诫要避开鲨鱼以及另外四种来自墨西哥湾的特定鱼类，而现在，又有三种鱼类被列入应避免食用的名单。但并非所有人都对这份新建议感到满意。批评者表示，新建议并不总是与该机构自己的科学研究结果一致。人们谈论孕妇和海产品时，汞确实是非常令人担忧的因素，但它并不是导致焦虑的唯一因素。

lines.en: The FDA maintains that its final consumption recommendations were based on thorough scientific analysis. Agency spokesman Cassell says the FDA believes their recommendations will increase confidence, not uncertainty. But critics disagree. They think the FDA's advice is not based on the evidence in its own detailed report, and so it confuses everyone.
lines.cn: FDA坚持认为，其最终的食用建议是基于全面的科学分析制定的。该机构发言人Cassell表示，FDA相信这些建议将增强信心，而不是增加不确定性。但批评者对此并不认同。他们认为，FDA的建议并没有以其自身那份详细报告中的证据为依据，因此让所有人都感到困惑。

lines.en: I know you're busy with work, but you also need to take some time off to recharge those batteries. So, should you plan one big vacation for the year, or should you take multiple short vacations throughout? Quantity can sometimes beat quality. First and foremost, regardless of how you use your vacation days, you need to be using them, and soon. The longer you put off your time off, the worse you're making things for yourself.
lines.cn: 我知道你忙于工作，但你也需要抽出一些时间休息，让自己的精力得到恢复。那么，你应该为这一年安排一次长假，还是应该在全年安排多次短假？数量有时胜过质量。首先，无论你如何使用假期，都需要真正使用它们，而且要尽快使用。你越是推迟休假，就越是在让自己的处境变得糟糕。

lines.en: One 9-year-long study published in Psychosomatic Medicine suggests not taking at least one vacation a year may increase your risk of mortality due to heart disease. So, not only are you killing your joy, you're possibly killing yourself. Give yourself a break, folks.
lines.cn: 《心身医学》发表的一项为期9年的研究表明，每年至少不休一次假，可能会增加因心脏病死亡的风险。所以，你不仅是在扼杀自己的快乐，也可能是在置自己于死地。各位，给自己放个假吧。

lines.en: When you should take those breaks, however, depends on a few factors: how many days you have available to use, what activities bring you joy, whether you have a family or not, and other variables come into play. Because of that, there's no perfect formula that works for everyone, but there are still a few things everyone can try to shoot for. We know that in terms of maximizing relaxation, you should aim for vacations that range somewhere between 7 and 11 days long. That gives you enough time to let go of your stress at work, completely loosen up, and achieve full-on calm.
lines.cn: 不过，你应该在什么时候休假，取决于几个因素：你有多少天可用假期、哪些活动能给你带来快乐、你是否有家庭，以及其他会产生影响的变量。正因为如此，并不存在适用于所有人的完美公式，但还是有几件事是每个人都可以努力做到的。我们知道，就最大限度地放松而言，你应该争取安排7到11天的假期。这样你就有足够的时间摆脱工作压力，彻底放松下来，达到完全平静的状态。

lines.en: That above-mentioned study also recommends you space out your vacations evenly instead of using up all of your days at once. Eight days might sound like a lot for someone who only gets 10 days of vacation a year. But if you frame them with weekends, you can manage two evenly spaced 8-day vacations a year. If you have 14 days of paid leave, that's almost three separate 8-day vacations you can use to split your year into thirds.
lines.cn: 上述研究还建议你把假期均匀地分散开来，而不是一次性用完所有假期。对于一年只有10天假期的人来说，8天听起来可能很多。但如果把周末安排在假期前后，你一年就可以安排两次间隔均匀的8天假期。如果你有14天带薪休假，那几乎可以安排三次分别为8天的假期，用来把一年分成三个阶段。

lines.en: As tempting as it might be to use all your days to take one long summer break, your overall goal should be to achieve the perfect balance between length plus joy and frequency. Vacation frequency is important because planning multiple breaks throughout the year means you always have something to look forward to. Planning things and the anticipation that comes with it tend to make us happier. If you only take one long vacation every year, the excitement builds much more slowly and seems so far off that it can actually lead to feelings of despair.
lines.cn: 尽管把所有假期都用来享受一次漫长的暑假可能很有吸引力，但你的总体目标应该是在假期长度、愉悦感和休假频率之间取得完美平衡。休假频率很重要，因为在全年安排多次休息意味着你总有值得期待的事情。筹划事情以及随之而来的期待往往会让我们更加快乐。如果你每年只休一次长假，兴奋感会积累得慢得多，而且由于假期看起来遥不可及，实际上可能会让人产生绝望感。

lines.en: Autonomous cars that can take over from drivers if they are tired or caught in the heat of an argument are being developed in Sweden. Researchers working as part of the European Union's €77 billion research program are developing sensor-based systems that monitor whether a driver is distracted, anxious or tired. If a driver is not in a fit state to be on the road, the car automatically takes control of the wheel to prevent accidents. Doctor Anna Anund from the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, who is leading the project, said a driver's state can be measured using a number of sensors, including heart rate monitors and eye sensors, which track where a driver's gaze is. She said the aim was to really make sure that the transition from the driver to the vehicle is done in a safe way, so we can take into consideration the driver's state, and so we do not give control to a driver who is under pressure of fatigue, stress, anxiety, and so on.
lines.cn: 在瑞典，人们正在研发能够在驾驶员疲劳或陷入激烈争论时接替其驾驶的自动驾驶汽车。作为欧盟770亿欧元研究计划一部分开展工作的研究人员，正在开发基于传感器的系统，用于监测驾驶员是否分心、焦虑或疲劳。如果驾驶员的状态不适合上路，汽车会自动接管方向盘，以防止发生事故。负责该项目的瑞典国家道路与运输研究所安娜·阿农博士表示，可以利用多种传感器测量驾驶员的状态，包括心率监测器和眼部传感器，后者可以追踪驾驶员的视线方向。她说，目标是真正确保从驾驶员到车辆的控制权转换以安全的方式完成，这样我们就能考虑到驾驶员的状态，也不会把控制权交给正承受疲劳、压力、焦虑等影响的驾驶员。

lines.en: According to data from the European Commission, Sweden has the safest roads in the EU, with the UK a close second. However, the number of road accidents in both has largely levelled out since 2010. Driver fatigue is thought to be responsible for as many as a fifth of road crashes across the EU, although there are certain times of the day when more accidents happen. At 6:00 a.m., for example, drivers are said to be 20 times more likely to have an accident than at 10:00 a.m. While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term, some have questioned whether it is safe.
lines.cn: 根据欧盟委员会的数据，瑞典拥有欧盟最安全的道路，英国紧随其后。不过，自2010年以来，两国的道路事故数量基本趋于平稳。据认为，驾驶员疲劳要对欧盟范围内多达五分之一的道路事故负责，尽管一天中某些时段发生的事故更多。例如，据称驾驶员在早上6点发生事故的可能性是在上午10点时的20倍。尽管大多数专家都认为，从长远来看，无人驾驶技术应有助于降低事故数量，但一些人质疑其是否安全。

lines.en: The researchers have said the technology they are developing is seeking to bridge the gap between Level 3 on the autonomy scale, in which drivers have to be ready to take control of the car at any point, and Level 4, in which driving is automated.
lines.cn: 研究人员表示，他们正在开发的技术旨在弥合自动驾驶等级体系中第3级与第4级之间的差距：在第3级，驾驶员必须随时准备接管汽车；而在第4级，驾驶过程实现自动化。

lines.en: Daniel Ruiz, the chief executive of the UK's connected and autonomous vehicle programme Meridian, said: "there is a strong debate going on about how it is possible to make a Level 3 car completely safe." Despite advances in technology, we still have some way to go in shifting public sentiment. With an increase in attention-grabbing accidents recently, drivers now view self-driving cars as less safe than they used to.
lines.cn: 英国互联与自动驾驶汽车项目Meridian的首席执行官丹尼尔·鲁伊斯说：“关于如何让第3级汽车完全安全，目前正在展开激烈的讨论。”尽管技术取得了进步，但要改变公众的看法，我们仍有一段路要走。随着近期引人关注的事故增多，如今驾驶员认为自动驾驶汽车不如过去安全。

sentence_insights.text:
S E N T E N C E I N S I G H T S · 句子精讲
83 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。

W: One mistake people make is to limit communication only to their bosses.
第2段，第1句
"名词 + 省略关系代词的定语从句 + is to do..." 是各类英语考试阅读与写作中高频出现的经典句式，掌握后具有很强的跨场景迁移复用价值。
It's important to expand your network and include your co-workers.
第2段，第2句
形式主语 "It is + adj. + to do" 是各类英语考试中高频出现的典型句式，掌握该句型后可无缝迁移至大量同类写作与阅读场景中。
M: But some of our co-workers are less senior to us.
第3段，第1句
"senior to" 属于高频易错的比较表达（不用 than 而用 to），在四六级与考研阅读中非常典型。
W: It's important not to underestimate your colleagues.
第4段，第1句
"It is + 形容词 + to do sth." 及其否定形式是各类英语考试中高频出现的核心句型，具备极高的写作与阅读迁移价值。
M: Now many of us think that working hard creates a good impression, but this isn't always true, is it?
第5段，第1句
采用“主句 + 宾语从句 + 并列转折主句”的经典句式，在各类英语考试阅读与议论文写作中出现频率极高，具有很强的教学与迁移价值。
We should avoid trying to take on too much work and constantly staying late, just to show that you are committed.
第6段，第2句
“主句 + 动名词并列宾语 + 不定式目的状语 + 宾语从句”属于四六级与考研阅读和写作中的高频典型句式，掌握后迁移价值极高。

W: Yeah, it's better to make sure you are putting in quality time instead of just a large quantity of time.
第8段，第1句
It is better to do sth ... 句型及 make sure 后接省略 that 的宾语从句在英语听力和阅读中极具代表性，掌握后可高频复用。
Should you try and go beyond your normal responsibilities and offer to help people with their projects?
第9段，第2句
"Should you do A and do B" 是日常交流与考试写作中极具代表性的建议询问句式，对于培养疑问句倒装感知力具有较高的复用价值。
W: Extend your assistance to those who need it, but only as long as your own work will not go unattended.
第10段，第1句
“祈使句 + 关系词定语从句 + 复合连词条件从句”是各类考试长难句中十分常见的说理句型，具备极高的迁移价值。
M: But it goes without saying that you shouldn't act like a know-it-all, otherwise you'll appear arrogant.
第11段，第1句
"It goes without saying that..." 与 "...otherwise..." 均属于四六级及考研写作与阅读中极高频、极具迁移价值的典型句式。
What does the woman advise people to do in their work?
第3题题干
特殊疑问词加上助动词倒装、动词带宾语及不定式补足语的结构在各类英语考试的听力与阅读题干中高频出现，具有极高代表性。

From what I recall, the presentation consists of five parts, not including the introduction and conclusion.
第1段，第2句
“介词 + 连接词从句”作依据状语配合主句及后置分词补充说明，是四六级与考研阅读及写作中非常经典且高频的句式结构。
In this way, we can both discuss the part of the project that we devoted most of our time to.
第3段，第2句
句首状语 + 情态动词 + 介词后置定语从句的组合在各类阅读真题中频繁出现，具有很高的模式识别与迁移训练价值。
I appreciate the rigorous work ethic you applied to the research, but not the sarcasm that comes up every time I mention it.
第5段，第5句
句中 "A, but not B" 的对比结构、省略关系代词的定语从句以及 "every time" 引导状语从句均属于四六级与考研真题中的高频典型句式，掌握后具有极高的迁移复用价值。
What do you think would be a fair arrangement?
第5段，第6句
"What do you think ..." 是英语口语、写作及各类考试听力阅读中高频出现的典型句式，掌握其结构拆解方法具有极高的迁移复用价值。
But as I struggled a bit with the statistics in the results section, how about you handling that?
第6段，第4句
"How about doing sth." / "How about sb. doing sth." 是英语口语与书面交流中高频出现的提议句式，结合从属从句提供背景的结构在各类阅读与写作中高度通用。

M: I will take responsibility for the conclusion and put you in charge of the introduction.
第8段，第1句
采用了 "will do A and do B" 并列谓语以及 "take responsibility for"、"put sb in charge of" 高频固定搭配，是职场与对话中极具代表性的高频常考句式。
This will make it so that we alternate presenting, so as to avoid sounding monotonous to the audience.
第8段，第2句
“make it so that...”以及“so as to do”均为四六级与考研真题中极高频出现的经典句式，具有很强的方法迁移价值。
What does the woman say they first need to do?
第5题题干
该句型是听力测试与日常阅读中极常见的“疑问主句 + 宾语从句”结构，掌握其拆解逻辑对提升复杂疑问句理解能力极具代表性。
Why does the man refuse to handle the background part?
第6题题干
“Why does + 主语 + 动词原形 + 不定式短语”是高频基础句型，具有很强的可迁移性。
He wants to devote his time to other portions.
第6题，A
“主语 + 谓语 + 不定式短语作宾语”是极高频的基础句型，搭配习惯表达迁移价值较高。
What does the woman urge the man to stop doing?
第7题题干
“What does sb urge sb to do?”是各类英语听力和阅读理解中极具代表性的高频提问句式，掌握其特殊疑问句倒装与非谓语补足语结构具有极高的迁移复用价值。

Why does the man suggest he present the conclusion and the woman do the introduction?
第8题题干
“表示建议/要求/命令的动词 + 宾语从句使用虚拟语气（should省略）” 是四六级及考研英语高频考查的典型句式。
According to new research from the University of Stirling in Scotland, although both men and women perceive women who wear makeup as being of a higher status, men associate makeup with prestigious, positive qualities, while women view other women wearing makeup as being dominant and a potential threat.
第1段，第2句
“句首状语 + 让步从句 + 主句 + 对比从句”的结构在学术研讨与真题阅读中极具代表性，掌握此类句式逻辑拆解可高度迁移。
The research showed that men and women both rated the faces with cosmetics as being more attractive, but only women rated made-up faces as being more dominant, while only men rated made-up faces as being higher in prestige.
第2段，第1句
句式呈现典型的学术研究结论汇报模式（"showed that ... but ..., while ..."），是四六级及考研阅读与写作中的高频优质样板。
Women rating women with makeup said they would be more jealous of them and thought they would be more attractive to men than their non-makeup wearing counterparts.
第3段，第2句
“主语 + 分词修饰 + 动词 + 省略 that 的宾语从句 + 比较级”是四六级与考研阅读真题中最典型的复杂句式之一，掌握后具有极高的迁移复用价值。
Cosmetic products are good for more than just giving you a pretty face.
第4段，第1句
“be good for + 动名词”以及“more than just”属于四六级与考研阅读中的高频句式，具有较高的复用与迁移价值。

At a job interview, knowing whether the hiring committee will consist of men or women might influence a female candidate's decision about wearing makeup.
第4段，第3句
本句覆盖了动名词短语作主语、名词性从句作动名词宾语、情态动词作谓语以及介词短语作后置定语和状语等多种典型成分，非常适合用来训练长主语切分与主干识别能力。
Whether the interviewers will view her as attractive, dominant and prestigious can affect the interviewers' actions and perhaps the outcome of the interview itself.
第4段，第4句
句首用 "Whether" 引导主语从句是英语四六级与考研真题中的高频常考句型，具有极高的示范性与迁移复用价值。
What can makeup do according to new research from the University of Stirling in Scotland?
第9题题干
句型 "What can ... do according to ..." 是各类英语考试阅读理解与听力材料中非常标准且高频的提问句式，代表性极强。
How did both men and women rate the faces with cosmetics in the new research?
第10题题干
“疑问副词 + 助动词前置 + 后置介词短语修饰”的结构在各类英语阅读与听力理解试题的题干中极为常见，具有很强的代表性。
No wonder people hope to make changes without it.
第1段，第6句
"No wonder + 句子" 是英语口语与写作中的高频典型表达，掌握其省缩结构与主干划分具有较强的迁移价值。

I define willpower as "using only the thought of your motivators to control your actions."
第2段，第1句
"动词 + 宾语 + as + 动名词短语/名词" 属于各类英语考试中高频出现的定义型句式，具有很强的语法迁移复用价值。
So, amazingly enough, willpower begins with a thought—a bright idea—some way to improve your life or contribute to others.
第3段，第1句
采用“主干 + 破折号同位语解释 + 不定式后置修饰”的结构，是四六级与考研阅读中极为常见的观点阐述句型，具有很高的迁移价值。
Whether you call it a motivator, a burning goal, or a bright idea, this idea is the force behind your willpower.
第4段，第2句
句首 "Whether... or..." 引导让步状语从句配合主句的结构在各类英语考试阅读中频繁出现，属于高度典型、迁移价值极高的高频常考句型。
What sort of bright ideas—motivators—make for effective willpower?
第5段，第1句
采用“疑问词作主语修饰语 + 插入语 + 谓语短语 + 宾语”的疑问句式，在真题阅读的引言或提问段落中较为常见，具有良好的迁移练习价值。
In fact, any goal that you value strongly counts.
第5段，第2句
"名词 + that 引导的定语从句 + 主句谓语" 是四六级与考研阅读中极为常见的主谓分隔句式，具有很高的迁移训练价值。
What does the speaker define willpower as?
第13题题干
该句型在英语阅读理解与听力试题的题干中极具代表性，掌握“疑问词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词 +宾语 + 介词”的结构规律可大量复用。

It equips us with an expert skill.
第14题，A
采用高频的“动词 + 宾语 + 介词短语”谓语搭配结构，是英语书面表达中高度典型的常用句型。
What does the speaker say may make for effective willpower?
第15题题干
此句式是四六级及考研英语阅读理解题干中极为高频的典型句型（如 "What does the author think..."），掌握后迁移复用价值极高。
For many pregnant women, understanding what seafood is safe and healthy and what should be avoided because of mercury concerns comes with a lot of worrying.
第1段，第1句
“长主语 + 从句嵌套 + 延后谓语”是四六级与考研英语长难句中极具代表性的常考结构，分析经验可高度复用。
In part, that's because the federal government's advice on the matter, first issued in 2004, has long been criticized as vague.
第1段，第2句
"That's because ..." 是四六级与考研阅读中极高频的因果归因句式，且从句常叠加后置定语修饰主语，具有极高的代表性与复用价值。
That guidance has included advice on how much seafood to eat, and which species pregnant and breastfeeding women should avoid over concerns about mercury contamination.
第1段，第3句
本句涵盖了现在完成时、情态动词、宾语从句中宾语前置（which species）以及介词短语作原因状语等多种经典语法点，非常适合用于练习非前置主语的从句成分划分。

According to a spokesman for the Food and Drug Administration, or FDA for short, the agency analyzed fish consumption data from more than 1,000 pregnant women in the US and found that 21 per cent of them ate no fish whatsoever in the previous month.
第2段，第2句
该句呈现了考研与四六级阅读中非常常见的“引用权威来源 + 机构做研究/发现 + 引导词带出数据结论”典型句式，迁移复用价值较高。
And those who did eat fish consumed far less than recommended by the dietary guidelines.
第2段，第3句
“代词 + 定语从句 + 谓语 + 比较级 + than + 分词省略”是各类英语考试真题中极为高频且典型的复杂比较句式，具有很强的范式迁移价值。
This week the FDA issued an update to the advice, listing more than sixty species in a chart that ranks fish as A Best Choice, Good Choice and Choices to Avoid.
第3段，第1句
“主句 + 分词短语补充说明 + 定语从句修饰名词”是四六级与考研阅读中最典型的高频长难句句型之一，极具迁移教学价值。
The goal is to make it easier for mothers-to-be to feel confident about the type of seafood they include in their diets.
第3段，第2句
句中使用形式宾语引导真正宾语的结构在四六级与考研真题中出现频率极高，属于高度典型且可大量迁移的必考句式。
The new advice recommends consumers choose a variety of fish to eat, and it comes with an easy-to-understand illustration of what an appropriate portion size should be—four ounces for an adult and two ounces for children aged four to seven.
第3段，第3句
该句型采用 "主句1 + and + 主句2 + 介词从句 + 举例说明" 的结构，属于四六级与考研阅读中科普、指南类文章极为常见的典型句式。

And while expectant mothers have long been warned to stay away from shark and four other particular types of fish from the Gulf of Mexico, now there are three new species on the list of what to avoid.
第4段，第1句
句型展现了阅读理解中常见的“while 让步背景 + 主句新信息”的典型转折层进结构，属于四六级与考研真题中的常考句式。
But not everyone is thrilled with the new advice.
第4段，第2句
包含“转折词 + 否定主语 + 被动谓语 + 介词短语”的标准结构，在四六级和考研阅读中极其常见，具有较高的通用复用价值。
While mercury is of great concern when people are talking about pregnant women and seafood, it's not the only factor contributing to anxiety.
第4段，第4句
由 "While" 引导的让步状语从句后接主句的结构在四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性，属于立论与转折表达的高频常考句式。
The FDA maintains that its final consumption recommendations were based on thorough scientific analysis.
第5段，第1句
“名词主语 + 观点动词 + that 宾语从句”是学术与新闻英语中极具代表性的高频句式，迁移价值极高。
Agency spokesman Cassell says the FDA believes their recommendations will increase confidence, not uncertainty.
第5段，第2句
在新闻报道与学术英语中，“主语 + 动词 + (that) 从句 + (that) 从句”的观点转述句式极为常见，代表性极强。

What does the speaker say about the federal government's advice on seafood safety?
第16题题干
这是标准听力与阅读理解题干中最常见的特殊疑问句结构，对培养学生快速抓取提问核心与修饰限定条件具有极高的练习复用价值。
It called on expectant mothers to pay attention to food safety.
第17题，B
句中 "call on sb. to do sth."（号召某人做某事）是考试阅读与写作中高度频现的规范句式，具有极强的代表性与可迁移性。
It listed more than sixty species of fish as "choices to avoid".
第17题，D
"list A as B" 是阅读与写作中极高频的动词搭配句式，结构规范且极具迁移复用价值。
According to the speaker, what are people concerned about regarding pregnant women and seafood?
第18题题干
属于听力与阅读理解题干中高度典型的提问句式（"According to..., what are people concerned about..."），实用性与复用价值极高。
I know you're busy with work, but you also need to take some time off to recharge those batteries.
第1段，第1句
该句式在日常口语与考试阅读中极具代表性，其转折并列结构以及不定式表目的的搭配属于高频常考且易于迁移复用的经典句型。
First and foremost, regardless of how you use your vacation days, you need to be using them, and soon.
第1段，第4句
句首状语/让步结构 + 主句主干的句式在四六级与考研阅读中非常高频，是议论文中表达劝诫与强调观点的典型句型。

The longer you put off your time off, the worse you're making things for yourself.
第1段，第5句
“the + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...”（越……就越……）是各类英语考试中极高频考查的比例比较句式，结构极其典范，掌握后可大量迁移复用。
One 9-year-long study published in Psychosomatic Medicine suggests not taking at least one vacation a year may increase your risk of mortality due to heart disease.
第2段，第1句
本句结构为英语学术报道和科普文章中极高频出现的句式（'研究表明+从句'），带有典型的前后修饰成分，高度契合各类考试真题的常见句型。
Because of that, there's no perfect formula that works for everyone, but there are still a few things everyone can try to shoot for.
第3段，第2句
包含了句首状语、"there be" 存现句的主谓倒置、关系代词引导的定语从句以及省略关系代词的定语从句和不定式作宾语，成分非常丰富，练习价值很高。
We know that in terms of maximizing relaxation, you should aim for vacations that range somewhere between 7 and 11 days long.
第3段，第3句
‘主句及物动词 + that 宾语从句 + 名词 + that 定语从句’ 是四六级与考研阅读中最典型、高频出现的高阶长难句结构之一，具备极高的迁移复用价值。
That gives you enough time to let go of your stress at work, completely loosen up, and achieve full-on calm.
第3段，第4句
采用了“give + 人 + 时间 + to do...”的高频句式，并展示了 A, B, and C 形式的不定式并列修饰结构，在阅读和写作中极具代表性。

That above-mentioned study also recommends you space out your vacations evenly instead of using up all of your days at once.
第4段，第1句
“主句动词 + 省略引导词的宾语从句 + 虚拟语气 + 不定式/介词短语修饰”是四六级与考研阅读中极其高频的典型句式。
If you have 14 days of paid leave, that's almost three separate 8-day vacations you can use to split your year into thirds.
第4段，第4句
句首 "If" 引导条件句 + 主句 "that is..." + 句末关系代词省略的定语从句，是四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的高频实用句型。
As tempting as it might be to use all your days to take one long summer break, your overall goal should be to achieve the perfect balance between length plus joy and frequency.
第5段，第1句
句首倒装让步结构与 "it" 形式主语结构均为四六级及考研真题阅读与写作中的高频典型句式，掌握后具有极强的迁移复用价值。
Vacation frequency is important because planning multiple breaks throughout the year means you always have something to look forward to.
第5段，第2句
“主句观点 + because 引导逻辑原因从句（内含动名词主语 + 宾语从句）”是议论文与阅读理解真题中高度高频且典型的长难句剖析句式。
Planning things and the anticipation that comes with it tend to make us happier.
第5段，第3句
“并列主语 + 后置定语从句修饰 + 使役动词 + 宾语 + 比较级作宾补”是四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的高频句型。

Taking more than three vacations yearly would prolong one's excitement.
第21题，C
该句展示了非常标准的“动名词短语作主语 + 情态/助动词谓语 + 名词宾语”句式，在四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性。
Autonomous cars that can take over from drivers if they are tired or caught in the heat of an argument are being developed in Sweden.
第1段，第1句
主语后接长定语从句隔离主谓语的结构在四六级和考研阅读中极具代表性，属于高频常考且分析方法可高度复用的经典句式。
Doctor Anna Anund from the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, who is leading the project, said a driver's state can be measured using a number of sensors, including heart rate monitors and eye sensors, which track where a driver's gaze is.
第1段，第4句
综合来看，该句结构高度典型，成分丰富且嵌套层次清晰，是极具代表性的优质语法拆解与划成分练习材料。
She said the aim was to really make sure that the transition from the driver to the vehicle is done in a safe way, so we can take into consideration the driver's state, and so we do not give control to a driver who is under pressure of fatigue, stress, anxiety, and so on.
第1段，第5句
综合来看，本句虽主干直观，但嵌套层级丰富、成分搭配多样且句式高度典型。作为剖析复杂从句修饰关系与训练长难句拆解能力的材料，具有极高的优先推荐价值。
According to data from the European Commission, Sweden has the safest roads in the EU, with the UK a close second.
第2段，第1句
“根据数据/来源 + 主句 + with伴随补充”是四六级与考研图表写作、新闻报道中高度典型的表达句式，复用性极强。

Driver fatigue is thought to be responsible for as many as a fifth of road crashes across the EU, although there are certain times of the day when more accidents happen.
第2段，第3句
“被动主干 + 让步状语从句 + 定语从句”是四六级与考研真题阅读中极其常见的学术说明文句式，掌握其层级切分与修饰关系具有很强的迁移复用价值。
At 6:00 a.m., for example, drivers are said to be 20 times more likely to have an accident than at 10:00 a.m.
第2段，第4句
“sb. is said to do sth.”句型与“倍数 + 比较级 + than”均属于各类英语考试中高频出现的标准常考句式，具有极高的迁移学习价值。
While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term, some have questioned whether it is safe.
第2段，第5句
"While... , some... whether..." 结构是四六级与考研阅读中高频出现的观点对比句式，掌握该句型的分析方法具有极高的迁移复用价值。
The researchers have said the technology they are developing is seeking to bridge the gap between Level 3 on the autonomy scale, in which drivers have to be ready to take control of the car at any point, and Level 4, in which driving is automated.
第3段，第1句
综合前五维评价，本句语法现象覆盖全面，结构典型且难易适中，极度推荐作为语法成分拆解、时态语态识别以及长难句层级分析的高优先级训练材料。
Despite advances in technology, we still have some way to go in shifting public sentiment.
第4段，第2句
句首使用 "Despite..." 引入让步状语、后接 "have some way to go in doing..." 表达“在某方面仍有路要走”属于各类英语考试中的高频地道句式，高度典型且易于迁移复用。

What did the researchers' project aim to do according to Dr. Anna Anund?
第23题题干
本句是极具代表性的阅读理解真题题干句式（以“What did ... according to ...”进行细节提问），对学生熟悉阅读理解常考提问句法具有很高的训练与复用价值。
Alleviate the driver's pressure as much as possible.
第23题，C
“动词原形 + 宾语 + as ... as possible” 是极为高频且典型的英语祈使与程度表达句式，掌握后具有很强的复用性。
Record the driver's state as accurately as possible.
第23题，D
“动词原形开头 + 宾语 + as ... as possible 状语”是英语指令性表达和考试中极具代表性的基础典型句式，掌握后可高频复用到写作与阅读中。
What is thought to be responsible for a fifth of road accidents across the European Union?
第24题题干
该句采用的 "What is thought/said to do..." 句式在四六级及考研英语阅读中极为常见，具有很强的结构代表性与迁移价值。

passage.directions: Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement

content.title: Meet the "digital nomads" who travel the world in search of fast Wi-Fi

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: For those "citizens of the world", the office can be anything from a beach hut in Brisbane to a Starbucks in Seattle, thanks to the growing prevalence of remote-based work. But roaming the globe from café to café is not without its challenges.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: When the average traveller lands in a city like Bangkok, Berlin, or Buenos Aires, their first step might be to drop their bags at their hotel and to log on to TripAdvisor to find out the hours of a popular tourist attraction or the best rooftop bar for happy hour.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text: But people like Pieter Levels are not your average traveller. A Dutch website developer, Levels has been living and working nomadically(像游牧民那样) in places like Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Manila for two years. With just a carry-on backpack, he chooses his location at will, based on a variety of factors—Wi- Fi speed, average temperature, exotic food and cost of living—that have little bearing on the work he actually does.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Somewhere in his nomadic journey, Levels noticed that there was a growing need to create an online infrastructure for people like himself. That's when he created #nomads, a membership-based chat system which runs on the team communication platform known as Slack. The channel allows users to ask people in their current city the types of practical questions that a tourist would unlikely need to ask.

paragraphs.label: E
paragraphs.text: Members of the geographically dispersed subculture that Levels is a part of call themselves "digital nomads". They are borderless, mostly self-employed remote workers who interact with cities in a way that's entirely different from a tourist, but still doesn't quite reach the status of resident. A relatively new phenomenon, there are no hard statistics on the prevalence of digital nomads or location independent workers. But thanks to the growing prevalence of freelance(自由职业的) livelihoods, a global sharing economy and numerous digital tools, the number of people who are able to live this life is growing quickly. And in a rapidly urbanising world, where a major city in Asia increasingly offers the same comforts as one in Europe, many people are reaching the realisation they don't need to stay in one place.

paragraphs.label: F
paragraphs.text: So how does a nomad differ from a tourist or resident? In many ways, Levels says, you can think of a digital nomad like a "short-term independent expat(移居国外的人)". Unlike a resident expat, they don't work for a large multinational company in an air conditioned office building and they generally enter a country on a tourist visa, simply renewing or moving on when it expires. But unlike a tourist, they don't arrive in a foreign city without any responsibilities. Travel isn't necessarily required for them to do their jobs, but neither is staying in one place.

paragraphs.label: G
paragraphs.text: Janet Brent is an independent ebook designer. She says many people she knows assume she travels for work, but in reality her international destinations are largely up to her, and driven by cost. "Contrary to what some people might think, I don't get paid to travel—I simply choose the lifestyle. Rather than rent in one given city, I choose to travel and do short-term, temporary stays around the world, and my travel decisions are literally based on what makes the most sense financially for me," Brent said. "It's completely different from vacationing—you really sink into the city life and get your feet wet in the communities."

paragraphs.label: H
paragraphs.text: Bryce Adams is another such nomad. He works as a developer for a South African company WooThemes, which has a workforce that's more than 80% remote-based. Though Adams frequently posts pictures on Instagram of his enviable cooking adventures from Seoul to Bangkok, he says nomad life in foreign cities has its downsides, including finding adequate Wi-Fi for the bandwidth-hungry work his livelihood depends on. Contrary to the perception that he works under a mango tree in a tropical haven, Adams says the reality of this life means that he often ends up staying in more western style places in globalised cities—ones that are sure to have air conditioning and a decent connection—rather than exotic beachfront cafés.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text: "A fellow nomad posted quite a funny but honest message on Twitter a few days ago that stuck with me: 'It's funny that digital nomads spend 16 hours to fly to the other side of the world to sit in Starbucks,' and it's completely true," Adams said. "When you're a digital nomad, you don't actually have as much freedom as most people think you do. We have deadlines, we all have people relying on us and a mouth (or two) that needs to be fed. It's nice to be able to work anywhere in the world but it's not without its challenges."

paragraphs.label: J
paragraphs.text: But these challenges can often provide an opportunity for nomads to see a side of a city they may not have if they were staying in a luxury hotel for a long weekend. However inconvenient, a trip to a local doctor, immigration office or laundry—or a conflict with a local Airbnb host (the accommodation style of choice for most nomads)—can be far more culturally instructive than a trip to the national museum. And because nomads often have to stay where the strongest internet connection is, they tend to spend more time in developing cities compared to the average tourist, who often flees to more touristy destinations soon after landing at the airport.

paragraphs.label: K
paragraphs.text: The nomad life is, by all accounts, one built out of privilege. You not only need a relatively powerful passport that makes tourist visas easy to attain, but also a knowledge economy job and access to the technology and devices that make remote working possible. But nomads like Adams say that while they are aware of this privilege, they believe living this way elevates what they're able to offer, by giving them a broader perspective on what they're building, writing, or designing and expanding their world view.

paragraphs.label: L
paragraphs.text: "Being able to travel and get around makes it easy to stay inspired," he added. "I truly believe that it makes me a more sensible human being, as I tend to see and appreciate the creative solutions people come up with in other parts of the world, even though many tend to have far more constraints than we have at home."

paragraphs.label: M
paragraphs.text: So when you're constantly on the road and don't own any property or have a fixed address, which city do you call home? It's no surprise that many nomads are dual citizens or "third culture kids," who have grown up with a notion of identity that's not tied to nationalism or staying in one place. Levels says that the nomad life has not only changed his notions of citizenship, but the people he chooses to spend time with as well. "Saying you're a 'citizen of the world' is a super cliché, right? But it's becoming quite true," Levels said. "This global awareness has been the reason I started Nomad List and it's affected who my friends are. It's normal to have dinner now and sit with a Korean girl, a British-Singaporean guy, a Mexican girl and a Nigerian guy. As much as that sounds like a politically correct TV advertisement, it's great that that's the time we're in now."

下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
A Dutch website developer, Levels has been living and working nomadically(像游牧民那样) in places like Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Manila for two years.
C段，第2句
句首同位语加单主干说明人物背景与近况的句式，在四六级和考研阅读的人物介绍段落中极其常见，迁移价值较高。

“主句 + 分词短语补充说明 + 破折号举例 + 嵌套定语从句”是四六级与考研阅读真题中极其高频的长难句结构，具有极高的教学与迁移价值。

D段，第2句
"That's when..." 句型搭配"名词 + 过去分词短语 + 定语从句"是英语真题中极高频出现的经典结构，迁移复用价值极高。
The channel allows users to ask people in their current city the types of practical questions that a tourist would unlikely need to ask.
D段，第3句
主句搭配不定式作补语并后接限制性定语从句是四六级与考研阅读中极其高频的真题句式，掌握其结构拆解对于提升长难句阅读能力极具代表性与复用价值。

属于典型的长难句构造模式——'主句主干简单 + 名词后接多层嵌套定语从句 + 内部对比转折'，在四六级与考研阅读中频繁出现。

“介词短语状语 + 带有定语从句的主语 + 谓语 + 方式状语”是四六级和考研阅读中极具代表性的常考单句结构，复用性极高。

E段，第5句
“前置状语/定语修饰 + 主句主干 + 同位语从句”是四六级与考研阅读真题中极具代表的高频复合句式，掌握其分析方法具有很高的迁移价值。

包含高度典型的 "How does A differ from B?" 句型，属于阅读与写作中高频出现的比较提问表达。

“否定常态特征 + 肯定实际做法 + 分词短语补充说明”是英文阅读与写作中非常典型的对比陈述句式，复用价值很高。

F段，第5句
本句包含了被动语态、动名词短语作主语、否定副词引发的倒装语序以及承前省略等多种常考语法现象，是非常优质的成分划分练习句。

句式展现了四六级与考研阅读中高频出现的“观点假设与真实情况转折对比”（"She says... but in reality..."）结构，代表性极强。

“状语从句 + 特殊疑问主句”是阅读与写作中的高频典型句式，其中“call A B”的宾补结构也是各类英语考试中的常考语法点。

句中的 "It's + 形容词 + to do sth" 是英语阅读与写作中最标准的典型句式之一，学懂后可以高频迁移到各类考试的同类句型解析中。

综合来看，本句时态虽然简单，但句法结构丰富且包含连续 "that"、形式主语与从句嵌套等多重语法坑点，是训练中高级句子结构拆解的优质素材。

content.passage: Children's use of social media is a problem. That doesn't mean it should be stopped. While younger children should not be on platforms where 13 is the minimum age, it is neither practical nor desirable to imagine a world in which teenagers are prevented from accessing the platforms and messaging systems that the adults around them use to organise their lives. But the pleasure and stimulation that people of all ages find on their screens and smartphones must not blind us to the harm that spending time in this way can cause. The finding that the alarmingly high rate of depression in British teenage girls is closely correlated to time spent on social media is extremely concerning. Research found that two in five girls are on social media for at least three hours a day—with half as many boys engaged to the same extent. More than a third of depressed girls have experienced online harassment. About half of affected girls suffered disrupted sleep, compared with 20% of depressed boys. Although the research does not prove that social media causes depression, the importance of the finding that there is a connection should not be underestimated. Schools have done important work in communicating key messages about the risks of online abuse. But when it comes to broader questions about "screen time", many professionals as well as parents are confused and uncertain. The health secretary, Matt Hancock, wants official guidelines on time and age limits. This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a greater degree of differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and it all depends on what you are doing. Also due this year is information commissioner Elizabeth Denham's Age Appropriate Design Code, covering the use of children's personal data. Both initiatives are welcome. But the government is playing catch-up. Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue. The failure to protect children from data harvesting and targeted advertising thus far is as shocking as the lack of concern shown by the companies themselves with regard to children's psychological health. Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services. There are other reasons for the rising incidence of depression in young people, with increasing pressure to succeed in education and in life more broadly—to be famous, beautiful, rich—often cited as a source of unhappiness or anxiety which can, if aggravated by other factors and not managed, tip into ill health. Safeguarding means more than the avoidance of physical threat. Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

content.passage: About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities. But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse. In a new study, we measured the excessive profits reported in tax havens that cannot be explained by ordinary economic activity such as employees, factories and research in that country. Our findings show a striking pattern of artificial shifting of paper profits to tax havens by corporations, which has been relentless since the 1980s. We found that the world's biggest multinational businesses shifted 37% of the profits—$969 billion—they earned in other countries to tax havens in 2019. The figure was less than 2% in the 1970s. The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens. We estimate that the amount of corporate taxes lost as a result reached 10% of total corporate revenue in 2019, up from less than 0.1% in the 1970s. In 2019, the total government tax loss globally was $250 billion. U.S. multinational corporations alone accounted for about half of that, followed by the U.K. and Germany. How do policymakers fix this? So far, the world as a whole has been trying to solve this problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way. In the past 40 years, the global effective corporate tax rate has fallen from 23% to 17%. At the same time, governments have relied more heavily on consumption taxes. But the root cause of profit-shifting is the incentives involved, such as generous or lenient corporate tax rates in other countries. If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist. This type of mechanism is exactly what more than 130 countries signed onto in 2021, with implementation of a 15% minimum tax set to begin soon in the EU, U.K., Japan, Indonesia and many other countries. The U.S. has notably not been able to pass this legislation. Our research suggests implementing this type of tax reform is necessary in reversing the shift of ever-greater amounts of corporate profits to tax havens—instead of being taxed by the governments where they operate and create value. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities.
第1段，第2句
“主句 + 宾语 + 定语从句修饰宾语 + 嵌套定语从句”在各类英语考试阅读中高频出现，掌握该句型的拆解方法具有极高的迁移价值。
In a new study, we measured the excessive profits reported in tax havens that cannot be explained by ordinary economic activity such as employees, factories and research in that country.
第3段，第1句
“主句 + 后置分词短语 + 限制性定语从句 + 举例介词短语”是四六级与考研阅读中极具代表性的学术论文句式，掌握后复用价值极高。
Our findings show a striking pattern of artificial shifting of paper profits to tax havens by corporations, which has been relentless since the 1980s.
第3段，第2句
主句带长后置定语、句末加逗号带 'which' 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明，是四六级与考研阅读学术真题中最常见的句型结构之一，极具迁移价值。
The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens.
第4段，第3句

We estimate that the amount of corporate taxes lost as a result reached 10% of total corporate revenue in 2019, up from less than 0.1% in the 1970s.
第5段，第1句

U.S. multinational corporations alone accounted for about half of that, followed by the U.K. and Germany.
第5段，第3句
"主句 + 过去分词短语（followed by...）作后置补充说明" 是四六级与考研阅读中极其常见且典型的常考句式，具有很高的迁移与复用价值。
So far, the world as a whole has been trying to solve this problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way.
第6段，第2句
“时间状语 + 主语 + 完成进行时谓语 + 不定式 + by 引导的手段状语”是各类阅读理解和写作中极其高频出现的典型句式，具有很强的可迁移性。
If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist.
第7段，第2句
本句是考研与四六级阅读中极具代表性的'条件从句 + 主句 + 原因从句'结构，且融合了虚拟语气表达，复用与迁移价值极高。
This type of mechanism is exactly what more than 130 countries signed onto in 2021, with implementation of a 15% minimum tax set to begin soon in the EU, U.K., Japan, Indonesia and many other countries.
第8段，第1句
句子采用了典型的表语从句结构与句末伴随状语搭配，非常符合四六级与考研英语真题的长难句考查习惯。
The U.S. has notably not been able to pass this legislation.
第8段，第2句
"be able to do" 及其完成时态表达在各类英语考试阅读中极为高频，且副词置于助动词之后的否定结构也是极为标准的规范书面语句式。

Our research suggests implementing this type of tax reform is necessary in reversing the shift of ever-greater amounts of corporate profits to tax havens— instead of being taxed by the governments where they operate and create value.
第9段，第1句
“主语 + 动词 + 宾语从句 + 介词短语修饰 + 定语从句末尾修饰”是英语阅读真题中最典型的复杂长难句句型之一。掌握此类句子的层级拆解与成分划分方法，可大量迁移至其他真题长难句中。
It has taken a toll on countries such as Cayman Islands.
第51题，B
句型结构为非常标准的“主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 介词短语状语”，在各类阅读考试中高频出现，具有良好的可迁移性。

"主语 + fail to do sth" 是表达未能达到某种结果的经典句型，在各类英语考试阅读理解中高频出现，具有极高迁移价值。
What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end?

more heavily on consumption taxes.
政策制定者应如何解决这一问题？到目前为止，世界各国总体上一直试图通过非常渐进地削减或取消企业
税来解决这一问题。在过去40年里，全球企业实际税率已从23%降至17%。与此同时，各国政府越来越
依赖消费税。
P7 But the root cause of profit-shifting is the incentives involved, such as generous or lenient
corporate tax rates in other countries. If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate
of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to
exist.
但利润转移的根本原因在于相关激励措施，例如其他国家慷慨或宽松的企业税率。如果各国能够就全球最
低企业税率达成一致，比如确定为20%，利润转移问题将基本消失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。
P8 This type of mechanism is exactly what more than 130 countries signed onto in 2021, with
implementation of a 15% minimum tax set to begin soon in the EU, U.K., Japan, Indonesia and many
other countries. The U.S. has notably not been able to pass this legislation.
这类机制正是2021年由130多个国家签署支持的方案；欧盟、英国、日本、印度尼西亚以及许多其他国家
将很快开始实施15%的最低税率。值得注意的是，美国一直未能通过这项立法。
P9 Our research suggests implementing this type of tax reform is necessary in reversing the shift of
ever-greater amounts of corporate profits to tax havens—instead of being taxed by the governments
where they operate and create value.
我们的研究表明，实施这类税制改革对于扭转企业利润越来越多地流向避税天堂的趋势是必要的；这些利
润本应由企业开展经营并创造价值所在国的政府征税。
题目与逐题解析
我们从G20遏制避税天堂使用的协议中了解到什么？
A) 加剧了非G20国家的问题。
B) 对开曼群岛等国家造成了损失。
C) 未能达到预期效果。
D) 未能形成任何长期计划。
【答案】C （细节题）
【判型】What do we learn about the G-20's agreement...? 询问关于该协议的事实信息，没有
infer/suggest/imply 等推断标志。
【拆句】What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens? 为
主谓宾结构，介词 on 后接动名词短语作后置修饰，整体无否定、比较等陷阱，平铺直叙。
【定位】About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack
down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that
aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities.
But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman
Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse.
大约十年前，世界最大经济体论坛 G-20 同意打击跨国企业滥用避税天堂的行为。这产生了
一项计划，旨在遏制将大量企业利润 shield 在税务机关之外的做法。但是，非但没有遏制
避税天堂的使用——例如巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国家——问题反而变得
更糟。

Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical
services. In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more
patients. Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas,
guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnosis systems help
doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis. The widespread
adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus
avoiding repeated examinations. Online medical consultation platforms have also greatly facilitated
patients' access to medical care. Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met
people's health needs.

逐句解析
本页整篇参考英译与逐句解析由公开资料基于2026年6月·第1套 英语六级汉译英（段落翻译）原卷题干译审整理。与试卷排版同一卷面：Directions 与一整段中文原文连续排印——整段连排、无段落标记无题号，把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作。卷面之后先给整篇参考英译定稿，再按自切句序逐句拆分：定英文主干、降级修饰成分、逐项落实语法点、句内定稿英译，答案直显。
真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Part IV
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。人工智能辅助诊断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患者病史，避免重复检查。线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
参考译文
整篇参考英译是复盘资产，考卷上只印中文原文——四六级 Part IV 翻译按整篇「表达通顺连贯、用词准确、语法正确」四档评分。
Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical services. In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients. Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis. The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations. Online medical consultation platforms have also greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care. Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's health needs.
【衔接】第1、2句间用时间状语承接
近年来自带时间推进，译 In recent years 置于第2句句首，自然把远程医疗这个实例挂到首句得到快速发展的总起之后，无需另加关联词。
四个并列实例句群，只在末例补 also
第3至6句是四个并列的应用实例（远程咨询、AI诊断、电子档案、线上平台），若每句都加moreover／in addition 会关联词堆砌、反而生硬；只在最后一例句首补一个 also（Online medical consultation platforms have also...），标示「再举一例、举例将尽」，轻重得当。
总结句前补 Overall
末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求是对前文的收束，中文靠语序暗示、英文需显性标记，句首补 Overall（Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met...），把「举例→总结」的信息流显化给阅卷人。
逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。
【主旨】科技赋能中国医疗的正式客观介绍
P1是典型的六级式社会科技介绍段：首句科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展总起，中间逐一举远程医疗、人工智能诊断、电子健康档案、线上平台四个应用实例，末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求收束升华。语体正式客观，英文用词应偏书面（consultation、facilitate 优于口语说法），句式以主谓主干句为主。
【时态】一般现在时
通篇客观介绍科技给中国医疗带来的现状与功能，陈述的是当下的一般事实与能力，如可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询、帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，故全篇以一般现在时为基调；凡带「了」「近年来」、表示已成结果的句子（如得到快速发展、极大地方便了患者就诊）合理偏离为现在完成时，表示动作已发生且结果延续至今。
【译法】科技进步
统一译作 advances in science and technology（约定俗成的固定搭配，advances 用复数表「多方面的进步」），锚回科技进步，全篇不再换用 technology development 等自造说法。
医疗事业
统一译作 medical services（也可作 healthcare，但全篇只取 medical services 一种），锚回医疗事业；「事业」在此语境下不译 cause/undertaking。
远程医疗
统一译作 telemedicine，这是国际通用的约定俗成译名，锚回远程医疗；不要自造 long-distance medical care 这类中式表达。
优质医疗资源
统一译作 high-quality medical resources（resources 用复数），锚回优质医疗资源。
偏远地区
统一译作 remote areas，作后置定语时为 in remote areas，锚回偏远地区患者。
人工智能辅助诊断系统
统一译作 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（AI-assisted 为连字符复合形容词，systems 复数表一类事物），锚回人工智能辅助诊 断系统；AI 为公认缩写，正式译文中可直接使用。
电子健康档案
统一译作 electronic health records（records 用复数），锚回电子健康档案，即国际通用的EHR，全篇不混用 electronic medical files。
线上医疗咨询平台
统一译作 online medical consultation platforms（platforms 复数），锚回线上医疗咨询平台；「咨询」取书面词 consultation，不用 asking doctors 这类口语。
治疗方案
统一译作 treatment plans（plans 复数），锚回治疗方案。
1. 科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。
【主干】科技进步作主语，带来作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展的核心动作是「使……得到快速发展」，提主干为Advances in science and technology（主语）+ have brought about（谓语）+ the rapid development of China's medical services（宾语）；「中国的医疗事业」整体降为宾语内部的修饰成分。
【降级】「使……得到发展」并入一个及物动词
「使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展」不宜逐字译成 make China's medical services get developed（典型中式英语），把「快速发展」做成名词短语 the rapid development of China's medical services 作宾语，用一个及物动词 brought about（带来）即可完整承载「使……得到」的因果语义。
【语法】时态
得到快速发展表示已发生且延续至今的结果，此处偏离全篇一般现在时的基调，改用现在完成时have brought about；若用一般现在时 brings about，会丢掉「已然实现」的意味。
主谓一致
主语中心词 advances 是复数，助动词用 have，不要误写为 has。
冠词与单复数
development 被 of China's medical services 限定为特指，前面加 the；medical services 用复数表医疗服务的统称。
【译文】Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical services.
2. 近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。
【主干】远程医疗作主语，使资源可及作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者的主语「远程医疗」照搬为 telemedicine；「使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者」用英文惯用复合宾语结构 has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients——「惠及」没有一个逐字对应的英文动词，make sth accessible to sb 是地道对译。
【降级】「近年来」降为时间状语前置
本句主干之外只有近年来一个成分，译为时间状语 In recent years 置于句首，既符合英文把时间状语放句首标示话题的习惯，又天然起到承接上句的作用；句内其余部分无需再降级。
【语法】时态
「近年来」标示从过去持续到现在，是现在完成时的典型信号，用 has made；这是基调时态的合理偏离。
主谓一致
主语 telemedicine 是不可数单数，助动词用 has，不要受中文无单复数标记影响写成 have。
单复数
「优质医疗资源」「更多患者」均为复数概念：high-quality medical resources、more patients，patients 不要漏掉 s。
【译文】In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients.
3. 医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。
【主干】医学专家作主语，提供咨询作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询给出明确主语「医学专家」→medical experts，谓语取「提供咨询」→can provide consultations；后半句指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案不另立谓语，留给降级处理。
【降级】方式状语前置，伴随动作分词化
「通过视频」→介词短语 Through video links 作方式状语置句首；「为偏远地区患者」→for patients in remote areas，其中「偏远地区」用介词短语 in remote areas 作 patients 的后置定语，不堆在名词前；「指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案」→现在分词短语 guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans 作伴随状语，「制定并实施」在 guide sb in doing sth 框架内用 and 连接两个动名词。
【语法】时态与情态
回指全篇基调用一般现在时，can 后接动词原形 provide；本句陈述的是当下的能力，不用完成时。
介词搭配
provide sth for sb（为某人提供某物）与 guide sb in doing sth（指导某人做某事）是固定搭配，介词 for／in 不可换、不可省。
单复数
consultations、treatment plans 均用复数表泛指的一类；experts、doctors 复数与中文「专家们／医生们」的群体义一致。
【译文】Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans.
4. 人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。
【主干】诊断系统作主语，帮助识别作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状主语照搬为 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（systems 复数表一类事物），谓语用 help sb do 结构：help doctors identify patients' early symptoms；「识别」紧跟 help 用原形。
【降级】「提高准确率」降为结果状语
提高诊断准确率是「帮助识别早期症状」带来的结果，译为 thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis 作结果状语挂句尾；「诊断准确率」不直译为 diagnosis correct rate（中式），用 the accuracy of diagnosis 这个名词化表达。
【语法】时态
陈述系统的一般功能，回指全篇基调用一般现在时 help。
动词用法
help 后接不带 to 的不定式：help doctors identify（to identify 也算对，但 identify 更简洁）；不要误写 help doctors identifying。
单复数
systems、doctors、symptoms 均用复数；symptoms 最易漏 s，注意「患者的早期症状」是多个症状。
【译文】AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis.
5. 电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患 者病史，避免重复检查。
【主干】普及作主语，使医生能够作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
电子健康档案的普及是「动词＋的＋名词」结构，译成名词化短语 The widespread adoption of electronic health records 作整句主语；「让医生能够」用 enable sb to do：enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories。
【降级】「避免重复检查」降为结果状语
避免重复检查是「快速了解病史」的直接结果，用 thus avoiding repeated examinations 作结果状语挂句尾；「让」译作 enable sb to do 已含「能够」义，「能够」不再另译 can，避免enable...to be able to 的冗余。
【语法】主谓一致
主语中心词是 adoption（单数），不是 records，谓语用 enables——长主语里隔着 of 短语时，最容易被末尾的复数名词带偏。
时态
陈述现实功能，回指基调用一般现在时。
单复数
records、histories 用复数；「病史」也可作 a patient's medical history，两种译法取一即可，全篇保持可数名词标记完整。
【译文】The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations.
6. 线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。
【主干】平台作主语，方便就诊作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊主语照搬为 Online medical consultation platforms；「方便了患者就诊」不逐字译 convenient for patients to see doctors（中式且破碎），用facilitate ＋名词化宾语：have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care。
【降级】「极大地」作副词修饰谓语
本句结构简单，无需降级：「极大地」→副词 greatly 直接修饰谓语动词；「患者就诊」名词化为patients' access to medical care 作宾语，access to 是固定搭配。
【语法】时态
「方便了」表已成事实且影响延续，偏离基调用现在完成时 have facilitated。
主谓一致与单复数
主语 platforms 复数，助动词用 have；platforms 的 s 不可漏。
介词搭配
access to 中的 to 是介词固定搭配，不可换成 for 或 of。
【译文】Online medical consultation platforms have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care.
7. 科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
【主干】深度融合作主语，满足需求作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
科技与医疗的深度融合译成名词化主语 The deep integration of technology and healthcare（integration 为中心词）；谓语「满足了」→has met；宾语人民的健康需求→people's health needs，needs 用复数。
【降级】「更好地」作副词嵌入谓语
本句为简单句，无成分需降级：「更好地」→better 置于助动词与过去分词之间（has better met），修饰「满足」的程度。
【语法】主谓一致
主语中心词 integration 是单数，助动词用 has；不要被 of 后面的 technology and healthcare两个名词带成 have。
时态
「更好地满足了」呼应全篇「已经实现的成果」，用现在完成时 has met，与首句 have brought about 首尾呼应。
单复数
「健康需求」是多种需求，needs 用复数；meet one's needs 为固定搭配。
【译文】The deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's health needs.

Part IV
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English.
You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。医
学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。人工智能辅助诊
断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患
者病史，避免重复检查。线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满
足了人民的健康需求。
参考译文
整篇参考英译是复盘资产，考卷上只印中文原文——四六级 Part IV 翻译按整篇「表达通顺连贯、用词准确、语法
正确」四档评分。
Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical
services. In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more
patients. Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas,
guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnosis systems help
doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis. The widespread
adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus
avoiding repeated examinations. Online medical consultation platforms have also greatly facilitated
patients' access to medical care. Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met
people's health needs.
【衔接】第1、2句间用时间状语承接
近年来自带时间推进，译 In recent years 置于第2句句首，自然把远程医疗这个实例挂到首句得到
快速发展的总起之后，无需另加关联词。
四个并列实例句群，只在末例补 also
第3至6句是四个并列的应用实例（远程咨询、AI诊断、电子档案、线上平台），若每句都加
moreover／in addition 会关联词堆砌、反而生硬；只在最后一例句首补一个 also（Online
medical consultation platforms have also...），标示「再举一例、举例将尽」，轻重得当。
总结句前补 Overall
末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求是对前文的收束，中文靠语序暗示、英文
需显性标记，句首补 Overall（Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare
has better met...），把「举例→总结」的信息流显化给阅卷人。
逐句解析
一整段连排中文、无段落标记无题号——把它切成一句句翻译单元本身就是解题动作，句前 N. 为逐句解析自切的
句序号（非考卷题号），与卷面中文逐字对应。
【主旨】科技赋能中国医疗的正式客观介绍
P1是典型的六级式社会科技介绍段：首句科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展总起，中间逐一
举远程医疗、人工智能诊断、电子健康档案、线上平台四个应用实例，末句科技与医疗的深度融合
更好地满足了人民的健康需求收束升华。语体正式客观，英文用词应偏书面（consultation、
facilitate 优于口语说法），句式以主谓主干句为主。
【时态】一般现在时
通篇客观介绍科技给中国医疗带来的现状与功能，陈述的是当下的一般事实与能力，如可以通过视
频为偏远地区患者提供咨询、帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，故全篇以一般现在时为基调；凡带
「了」「近年来」、表示已成结果的句子（如得到快速发展、极大地方便了患者就诊）合理偏离为
现在完成时，表示动作已发生且结果延续至今。
【译法】科技进步
统一译作 advances in science and technology（约定俗成的固定搭配，advances 用复数表「多
方面的进步」），锚回科技进步，全篇不再换用 technology development 等自造说法。
医疗事业
统一译作 medical services（也可作 healthcare，但全篇只取 medical services 一种），锚回医
疗事业；「事业」在此语境下不译 cause/undertaking。
远程医疗
统一译作 telemedicine，这是国际通用的约定俗成译名，锚回远程医疗；不要自造 long-distance
medical care 这类中式表达。
优质医疗资源
统一译作 high-quality medical resources（resources 用复数），锚回优质医疗资源。
偏远地区
统一译作 remote areas，作后置定语时为 in remote areas，锚回偏远地区患者。
人工智能辅助诊断系统
统一译作 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（AI-assisted 为连字符复合形容词，systems 复数表一
类事物），锚回人工智能辅助诊 断系统；AI 为公认缩写，正式译文中可直接使用。
电子健康档案
统一译作 electronic health records（records 用复数），锚回电子健康档案，即国际通用的
EHR，全篇不混用 electronic medical files。
线上医疗咨询平台
统一译作 online medical consultation platforms（platforms 复数），锚回线上医疗咨询平台；
「咨询」取书面词 consultation，不用 asking doctors 这类口语。
治疗方案
统一译作 treatment plans（plans 复数），锚回治疗方案。
1. 科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。
【主干】科技进步作主语，带来作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展的核心动作是「使……得到快速发展」，提主干为
Advances in science and technology（主语）+ have brought about（谓语）+ the rapid
development of China's medical services（宾语）；「中国的医疗事业」整体降为宾语内部的修
饰成分。
【降级】「使……得到发展」并入一个及物动词
「使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展」不宜逐字译成 make China's medical services get
developed（典型中式英语），把「快速发展」做成名词短语 the rapid development of China's
medical services 作宾语，用一个及物动词 brought about（带来）即可完整承载「使……得到」
的因果语义。
【语法】时态
得到快速发展表示已发生且延续至今的结果，此处偏离全篇一般现在时的基调，改用现在完成时
have brought about；若用一般现在时 brings about，会丢掉「已然实现」的意味。
主谓一致
主语中心词 advances 是复数，助动词用 have，不要误写为 has。
冠词与单复数
development 被 of China's medical services 限定为特指，前面加 the；medical services 用复
数表医疗服务的统称。
【译文】Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of
China's medical services.
2. 近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。
【主干】远程医疗作主语，使资源可及作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者的主语「远程医疗」照搬为 telemedicine；「使优质医疗资
源惠及更多患者」用英文惯用复合宾语结构 has made high-quality medical resources
accessible to more patients——「惠及」没有一个逐字对应的英文动词，make sth accessible
to sb 是地道对译。
【降级】「近年来」降为时间状语前置
本句主干之外只有近年来一个成分，译为时间状语 In recent years 置于句首，既符合英文把时间
状语放句首标示话题的习惯，又天然起到承接上句的作用；句内其余部分无需再降级。
【语法】时态
「近年来」标示从过去持续到现在，是现在完成时的典型信号，用 has made；这是基调时态的合
理偏离。
主谓一致
主语 telemedicine 是不可数单数，助动词用 has，不要受中文无单复数标记影响写成 have。
单复数
「优质医疗资源」「更多患者」均为复数概念：high-quality medical resources、more
patients，patients 不要漏掉 s。
【译文】In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to
more patients.
3. 医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。
【主干】医学专家作主语，提供咨询作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询给出明确主语「医学专家」→medical experts，
谓语取「提供咨询」→can provide consultations；后半句指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案不另
立谓语，留给降级处理。
【降级】方式状语前置，伴随动作分词化
「通过视频」→介词短语 Through video links 作方式状语置句首；「为偏远地区患者」→for
patients in remote areas，其中「偏远地区」用介词短语 in remote areas 作 patients 的后置定
语，不堆在名词前；「指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案」→现在分词短语 guiding local doctors
in developing and implementing treatment plans 作伴随状语，「制定并实施」在 guide sb in
doing sth 框架内用 and 连接两个动名词。
【语法】时态与情态
回指全篇基调用一般现在时，can 后接动词原形 provide；本句陈述的是当下的能力，不用完成
时。
介词搭配
provide sth for sb（为某人提供某物）与 guide sb in doing sth（指导某人做某事）是固定搭
配，介词 for／in 不可换、不可省。
单复数
consultations、treatment plans 均用复数表泛指的一类；experts、doctors 复数与中文「专家
们／医生们」的群体义一致。
【译文】Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in
remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans.
4. 人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。
【主干】诊断系统作主语，帮助识别作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状主语照搬为 AI-assisted diagnosis systems
（systems 复数表一类事物），谓语用 help sb do 结构：help doctors identify patients' early
symptoms；「识别」紧跟 help 用原形。
【降级】「提高准确率」降为结果状语
提高诊断准确率是「帮助识别早期症状」带来的结果，译为 thereby improving the accuracy of
diagnosis 作结果状语挂句尾；「诊断准确率」不直译为 diagnosis correct rate（中式），用 the
accuracy of diagnosis 这个名词化表达。
【语法】时态
陈述系统的一般功能，回指全篇基调用一般现在时 help。
动词用法
help 后接不带 to 的不定式：help doctors identify（to identify 也算对，但 identify 更简洁）；
不要误写 help doctors identifying。
单复数
systems、doctors、symptoms 均用复数；symptoms 最易漏 s，注意「患者的早期症状」是多
个症状。
【译文】AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby
improving the accuracy of diagnosis.
5. 电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患 者病史，避免重复检查。
【主干】普及作主语，使医生能够作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
电子健康档案的普及是「动词＋的＋名词」结构，译成名词化短语 The widespread adoption of
electronic health records 作整句主语；「让医生能够」用 enable sb to do：enables doctors
to quickly review patients' medical histories。
【降级】「避免重复检查」降为结果状语
避免重复检查是「快速了解病史」的直接结果，用 thus avoiding repeated examinations 作结果
状语挂句尾；「让」译作 enable sb to do 已含「能够」义，「能够」不再另译 can，避免
enable...to be able to 的冗余。
【语法】主谓一致
主语中心词是 adoption（单数），不是 records，谓语用 enables——长主语里隔着 of 短语时，
最容易被末尾的复数名词带偏。
时态
陈述现实功能，回指基调用一般现在时。
单复数
records、histories 用复数；「病史」也可作 a patient's medical history，两种译法取一即可，
全篇保持可数名词标记完整。
【译文】The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly
review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations.
6. 线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。
【主干】平台作主语，方便就诊作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊主语照搬为 Online medical consultation platforms；
「方便了患者就诊」不逐字译 convenient for patients to see doctors（中式且破碎），用
facilitate ＋名词化宾语：have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care。
【降级】「极大地」作副词修饰谓语
本句结构简单，无需降级：「极大地」→副词 greatly 直接修饰谓语动词；「患者就诊」名词化为
patients' access to medical care 作宾语，access to 是固定搭配。
【语法】时态
「方便了」表已成事实且影响延续，偏离基调用现在完成时 have facilitated。
主谓一致与单复数
主语 platforms 复数，助动词用 have；platforms 的 s 不可漏。
介词搭配
access to 中的 to 是介词固定搭配，不可换成 for 或 of。
【译文】Online medical consultation platforms have greatly facilitated patients' access to
medical care.
7. 科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
【主干】深度融合作主语，满足需求作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）
科技与医疗的深度融合译成名词化主语 The deep integration of technology and healthcare
（integration 为中心词）；谓语「满足了」→has met；宾语人民的健康需求→people's health
needs，needs 用复数。
【降级】「更好地」作副词嵌入谓语
本句为简单句，无成分需降级：「更好地」→better 置于助动词与过去分词之间（has better
met），修饰「满足」的程度。
【语法】主谓一致
主语中心词 integration 是单数，助动词用 has；不要被 of 后面的 technology and healthcare
两个名词带成 have。
时态
「更好地满足了」呼应全篇「已经实现的成果」，用现在完成时 has met，与首句 have brought
about 首尾呼应。
单复数
「健康需求」是多种需求，needs 用复数；meet one's needs 为固定搭配。
【译文】The deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's
health needs.

真题卷第1套(2026-06) • 英语六级
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "With the
trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for Nature." You
can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at
least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of
your essay.
content.model_essay:
With the trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for
Nature. As concrete forests expand, many urban dwellers rarely feel the breeze, hear birds, or touch soil. A
stronger bond with nature is not a luxury; it is essential for mental and physical well-being in an increasingly
artificial environment.
One practical way to cultivate this love is to make nature part of daily routines. For example, residents can
walk in nearby parks, grow plants on balconies, or join community gardening projects. These activities
reconnect people with the living world. Last year, I started visiting a small riverbank park every weekend.
Watching seasons change there reduced my stress and made me more aware of environmental protection.
Therefore, city governments and individuals should work together to create more green spaces and spend time
in them. Only by integrating nature into urban life can residents truly develop a stronger love for it and build
healthier cities for future generations.
content.model_essay_cn:
随着城市化的趋势，城市居民培养对自然更深厚的热爱至关重要。随着混凝土森林的扩张，许多城市居民
很少感受到微风、听到鸟鸣或触摸土壤。在日益人造化的环境中，对自然的更紧密联系不是奢侈品，而是
身心健康的必需品。
培养这种热爱的一个实用方法是让自然成为日常生活的一部分。例如，居民可以在附近公园散步、在阳台
种植植物或参加社区园艺项目。这些活动使人们重新与有生命的世界连接。去年，我开始每个周末去一个
小河岸公园。在那里观察季节变化减轻了我的压力，也使我更关注环境保护。
因此，城市政府和个人应共同努力创造更多绿色空间，并花时间置身其中。只有将自然融入城市生活，居
民才能真正培养更深厚的热爱，并为后代建设更健康的城市。
content.paragraph_notes:
首段落实首句照抄与论点回应。范文首句完全复制 With the trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for Nature.，随后用 'concrete forests expand' 描述城市化现象，并以 'not a luxury; it is essential' 亮明观点。

中段用做法+例子+个人经历展开。主题句 'One practical way to cultivate this love...' 对应paragraphGuide 的方法；'For example...' 列举具体做法；'Last year, I started visiting...' 加入个人经历，使论证更可信。

末段总结并发出行动呼吁。'Therefore, city governments and individuals...' 总结对策，'Only by integrating nature into urban life...' 用倒装句升华，回扣首段论点。
A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。

Part I
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence
"With the trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love
for Nature." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your
essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence
given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
【参考范文 · 164 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
With the trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for
Nature. As concrete forests expand, many urban dwellers rarely feel the breeze, hear birds, or touch soil. A
stronger bond with nature is not a luxury; it is essential for mental and physical well-being in an increasingly
artificial environment.
One practical way to cultivate this love is to make nature part of daily routines. For example, residents can
walk in nearby parks, grow plants on balconies, or join community gardening projects. These activities
reconnect people with the living world. Last year, I started visiting a small riverbank park every weekend.
Watching seasons change there reduced my stress and made me more aware of environmental protection.
Therefore, city governments and individuals should work together to create more green spaces and spend time
in them. Only by integrating nature into urban life can residents truly develop a stronger love for it and build
healthier cities for future generations.
【参考译文】
随着城市化的趋势，城市居民培养对自然更深厚的热爱至关重要。随着混凝土森林的扩张，许多城市居民
很少感受到微风、听到鸟鸣或触摸土壤。在日益人造化的环境中，对自然的更紧密联系不是奢侈品，而是
身心健康的必需品。
培养这种热爱的一个实用方法是让自然成为日常生活的一部分。例如，居民可以在附近公园散步、在阳台
种植植物或参加社区园艺项目。这些活动使人们重新与有生命的世界连接。去年，我开始每个周末去一个
小河岸公园。在那里观察季节变化减轻了我的压力，也使我更关注环境保护。
因此，城市政府和个人应共同努力创造更多绿色空间，并花时间置身其中。只有将自然融入城市生活，居
民才能真正培养更深厚的热爱，并为后代建设更健康的城市。

vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for Nature.，随后用 'concrete
forests expand' 描述城市化现象，并以 'not a luxury; it is essential' 亮明观点。
【第 2 段】中段用做法+例子+个人经历展开。主题句 'One practical way to cultivate this love...' 对应
paragraphGuide 的方法；'For example...' 列举具体做法；'Last year, I started visiting...' 加入个人经
历，使论证更可信。
【第 3 段】末段总结并发出行动呼吁。'Therefore, city governments and individuals...' 总结对
策，'Only by integrating nature into urban life...' 用倒装句升华，回扣首段论点。

labeled_paragraphs.text: And just read a single poem. In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large. The negotiation, between you and it, is the heart of the matter. What does the poet see that you don't? What does the difference mean? It could be one of the best conversations you ever have. Forget self-help books; reading is self-help in action.

labeled_paragraphs.label: B
labeled_paragraphs.text: But for the most part, this isn't what the business community does. I have yet to meet a chief executive who reads regularly. Many skip newspapers, and magazines are a stretch. They don't have time, they say. It's inefficient; they can get the information they need from those around them. At a pinch, they might pick up a business book before a long flight, in the hope that, like a cookbook, it will provide a foolproof recipe. Some are drawn to what I think of as "business car crash" books — the stories of Theranos, Purdue, or WeWork. But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.

labeled_paragraphs.label: C
labeled_paragraphs.text: Neuroscientists have been at pains to demonstrate that the pleasure a book provides isn't indulgence; it's good for you. Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate. Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers. Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states. Our imagination — remember that? — is rekindled.

labeled_paragraphs.label: D
labeled_paragraphs.text: It is undoubtedly true that all work and no play really does make Jack, or Jill, dull. The cure is right at hand. Reading is cheap, easy and, most important, it's fun. Liberate your imagination this year.

labeled_paragraphs.label: E
labeled_paragraphs.text: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery. Daunted by uncertainty? Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina. "We are never sure of anything," says the physicist (and writer) Carlo Rovelli.

labeled_paragraphs.label: F
labeled_paragraphs.text: You don't need to get out more. If, like most business people, you spend your life dashing from office to plane, train to home, boardroom to washroom, what you really need to do is stay in more, sit down — and read a book.

labeled_paragraphs.label: G
labeled_paragraphs.text: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands. (And yes, all these benefits are more closely associated with physical books than digital ones.)
